        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      \n      // Update overlay image element\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        // Check if image is preloaded\n        if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(transitionData.image)) {\n          imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n        } else {\n          // Preload if not already loaded\n          const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n          tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', transitionData.image);\n          if (this.transitionsManager) {\n            await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n          } else {\n            await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n          }\n          imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n        }\n        \n        if (transitionData.alt) {\n          imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Update copy text if element exists\n      const copyElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__copy');\n      if (copyElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.copy) {\n        copyElement.textContent = transitionData.copy;\n      }\n\n      // Clear sessionStorage after restoring\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error restoring transition data:', error);\n      // Clear corrupted data\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nsetupTransitionTemplates() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a transition template HTML string for a given route\n   * @param {string} route - The route identifier (e.g., \"home\", \"section-1\")\n   * @param {Object} data - Route configuration data from siteConfig\n   * @param {Object} data.transition - Transition configuration\n   * @param {string} data.transition.copy - Text to display during transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.image - Image URL for the transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.alt - Alt text for the transition image\n   * @returns {string} HTML template string with transition markup\n   * \n   * Removed:\n   * &lt;p class=\"page-transition-overlay__copy\"&gt;${data.transition.copy}&lt;/p&gt;\n   */\n  createTransitionTemplate(route, data) {\n    return &#96;&lt;template ${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"&gt;\n      &lt;img\n        class=\"page-transition-overlay__image\"\n        ${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC}=\"${data.transition.image}\"\n        alt=\"${data.transition.alt}\"\n      /&gt;\n    &lt;/template&gt;&#96;;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize preloading strategy for transition images\n   * Uses requestIdleCallback when available, otherwise falls back to setTimeout\n   * Preloading happens during browser idle time to avoid blocking main thread\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Constants for the application\n * Prevent the use of \"magic strings\" by providing a single source of truth for all selectors, attributes, events, and other constants used across the app\n * Wrap objects in Object.freeze() to prevent mutation outside of this class\n *\n * Problems with \"magic strings\":\n * - Typos not caught until runtime\n * - Hard to refactor (change selector? search entire codebase!)\n * - No single source of truth\n * - Easy to miss when updating\n */\n\n/**\n * CSS selectors\n */\nexport const SELECTORS = Object.freeze({\n  // Main structure\n  MAIN: \"main\",\n  MAIN_WITH_TEMPLATE: \"main[data-template]\",\n  BODY: \"body\",\n\n  // Preloader\n  PRELOADER: \".preloader\",\n  PRELOADER_TITLE: \".preloader h1\",\n  PRELOADER_COUNTER: \".preloader-counter\",\n  PRELOADER_COPY: \".preloader-transition-copy h1\",\n  PRELOADER_COPY_CONTAINER: \".preloader-transition-copy\",\n  PRELOADER_IMAGE: \"img[data-src].preloader-transition-image__img\",\n\n  // Page transitions\n  TRANSITION_OVERLAY: \".page-transition-overlay\",\n  TRANSITION_TEMPLATES: \"#page-transition-overlay-templates\",\n  TRANSITION_COPY: \".page-transition-overlay__copy\",\n  TRANSITION_IMAGE: \".page-transition-overlay__image\",\n\n\n  // Footnotes\n  FOOTNOTES: \"ul.footnotes li\",\n  SUPERSCRIPT_LINKS: \".page-content a.footnote-superscript-link\",\n  SUPERSCRIPT_LINK: \"a.footnote-superscript-link\",\n  FOOTNOTE_LINK: \"a.footnote-link\",\n\n\n  // Navigation\n  NAV: \"nav\",\n  NAV_LINKS: \"nav a\",\n  LINK: \".link\",\n  INTERNAL_LINK: \"a.internal-link\",\n  NAV_TOGGLE: \".navigation__toggle\",\n  NAV_TITLE: \".navigation__title\",\n\n  // Page content\n  PAGE_CONTENT: \"section.page-template\",\n\n  // Images\n  LAZY_IMAGES: \"img[data-src]\",\n\n  // Animations\n  ANIMATIONS_ATTRIBUTE: \"[data-animation]\",\n  TITLE_ANIMATIONS: '[data-animation=\"title\"]',\n  \n  // HTML elements\n  TEMPLATE: \"template\",\n  IMG: \"img\",\n});\n\n/**\n * HTML attribute names\n */\nexport const ATTRIBUTES = Object.freeze\n;",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Site Routes Configuration\n * Central configuration data for all routes, page classes, and transition data\n * Separated from SiteConfig class logic for better maintainability\n */\n\nexport const siteRoutes = {\n  '/': {\n    template: \"home\",\n    class: \"Home\",\n    link: \"/\",\n    url: \"/pages/index.html\",\n    title: \"The Shea Memorandum\",\n    metaDescription: \"The Shea Memorandum examines Israeli surveillance of 9/11 hijackers and FBI suspects, revealing critical intelligence failures before September 11, 2001.\",\n    transition: {\n      image: \"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-section-desktop.webp\",\n      copy: \"The Shea Memorandum\",\n      alt: \"The Shea Memorandum\",\n    },\n  },\n  '/introduction': {\n    template: \"introduction\",\n    class: \"Introduction\",\n    link: \"/introduction\",\n    url: \"/pages/introduction.html\",\n    title: \"Introduction\",\n    metaDescription: \"Introduction to The Shea Memorandum: A comprehensive investigation into Israeli surveillance of future 9/11 hijackers and the failure to provide adequate warning.\",\n    transition: {\n      image: \"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp\",\n      copy: \"Introduction\",\n      alt: \"Introduction\",\n    },\n  },\n  \"/section-1\": {\n    template: \"section-1\",\n    class: \"View\",\n    link: \"/section-1\",\n    url: \"/pages/section-1.html\",\n    title: \"General Preliminary Conclusions\",\n    metaDescription: \"General preliminary conclusions from The Shea Memorandum regarding Israeli DEA groups' surveillance of 9/11 hijackers before the attacks.\",\n    transition: {\n      image: \"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/section-1-desktop.webp\",\n      copy: \"General Preliminary Conclusions\",\n      alt: \"General Preliminary Conclusions\",\n    },\n  },\n  \"/section-2\": {\n    template: \"section-2\",\n    class: \"View\",\n,\n};",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

          {
            "text": "    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nsetupListeners() {\nasync (event) =&gt; {\n\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n        \n        if (route &amp;&amp; this.siteConfig) {\n          // 2. Update overlay with transition data\n          await this.updateTransitionOverlay(route);\n          \n          // 3. Store transition data in sessionStorage\n          const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n          if (routeConfig &amp;&amp; routeConfig.transition) {\n            this.storeTransitionData(routeConfig.transition);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 4. Show transition\n        await this.showTransition();\n        \n        // 5. Navigate to new page\n        this.sessionStorage.setItem(\"pageTransition\", \"true\");\n        window.location.href = href;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error in page transition:', error);\n        // Fallback: navigate without transition\n        window.location.href = href;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  async showTransition() {\n    return new Promise\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "# How-To Guide\n\n## Table of Contents\n- [Creating a New Page](#creating-a-new-page)\n- [Page Registry Setup](#page-registry-setup)\n- [Animation System](#animation-system)\n- [Image Preloading](#image-preloading)\n- [Page Transitions](#page-transitions)\n- [Authoring Page Animations](#authoring-page-animations)\n- [Using Page Lifecycle Hooks](#using-page-lifecycle-hooks)\n- [Creating Custom Components](#creating-custom-components)\n\n## Creating a New Page\n\nThis guide walks you through creating a complete new page from scratch.\n\n### Step 1: Register in SiteConfig\n\nFirst, add your page configuration to &#96;app/config/SiteConfig.js&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// In SiteConfig.initializeSettings()\n'my-new-page': {\n  template: \"my-new-page\",        // Must match data-template in HTML\n  class: \"MyNewPage\",              // JavaScript class name\n  link: \"/my-new-page\",            // URL path\n  url: \"/pages/my-new-page.html\",  // HTML file path\n  transition: {\n    image: \"https://example.com/transition-image.jpg\",\n    copy: \"My New Page\",           // Text shown during transition\n    alt: \"Transition image alt text\"\n  },\n},\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Important Notes:**\n- &#96;template&#96; must match the &#96;data-template&#96; attribute in your HTML\n- &#96;class&#96; must match your JavaScript class name\n- &#96;link&#96; is the URL path users will navigate to\n- &#96;url&#96; is the path to the HTML file (used by PageManager.fetch)\n\n### Step 2: Create HTML Template\n\nCreate your HTML template in &#96;views/pages/my-new-page.html&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n{% extends \"layouts/page.html\" %}\n{% block title %}My New Page{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n&lt;main class=\"my-new-page\" data-template=\"my-new-page\" data-background=\"#ffffff\" data-color=\"#000000\"&gt;\n  &lt;section class=\"page-content\"&gt;\n    &lt;article&gt;\n      ",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "lineNumber": 12

          {
            "text": "## Creating a New Page",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "This guide walks you through creating a complete new page from scratch.",
            "lineNumber": 15

          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "### Step 1: Register in SiteConfig",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "First, add your page configuration to &#96;app/config/SiteConfig.js&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "// In SiteConfig.initializeSettings()",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "'my-new-page': {",

          {
            "text": "  template: \"my-new-page\",        // Must match data-template in HTML",

          },
          {
            "text": "  link: \"/my-new-page\",            // URL path",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "  url: \"/pages/my-new-page.html\",  // HTML file path",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "  transition: {",

            "text": "    image: \"https://example.com/transition-image.jpg\",",
            "lineNumber": 29

          {

Create new instance.&#96;);\n  }\n  \n  // ✅ Set flag BEFORE doing work\n  this._created = true;\n  \n  // Now safe to do initialization\n  this.element = $(this.selector);\n  this.elements = pageObject(this.selectorChildren);\n  this.transitionOverlay = document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\");\n  \n  // ✅ Check before creating instances (or inject dependencies)\n  if (!this.transitionManager) {\n    this.transitionManager = new TransitionManager();\n  }\n  this.transitionManager.setupTransitionTemplates();\n  \n  if (!this.smoothScroll) {\n    this.smoothScroll = new SmoothScroll();\n  }\n  \n  this.footnotes = new Footnotes({smoothScroll: this.smoothScroll});\n  this.createAnimations();\n  this.setupEventListeners();\n  this.preloader = document.querySelector(\".preloader\");\n  this.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, {immediate: true});\n}\n\ndestroy() {\n  // ✅ Guard: Check if already destroyed",

        "contents": "@layer components {\n  .page-transition-overlay {\n    inset: 0;\n    opacity: 0;\n    pointer-events: none;\n    position: fixed;\n    z-index: var(--z-index-page-transition);\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: 1fr;\n    grid-template-rows: 1fr;\n    justify-content: center;\n    align-items: center;\n    will-change: opacity; /* Hint to browser for GPU acceleration */\n    background-color: var(--color-white);\n\n    &amp;__copy {\n      opacity: 0;\n      color: black;\n      grid-column: 1 / 2;\n      grid-row: 1 / 2;\n      z-index: var(--z-index-page-transition-copy);\n      text-align: center;\n      justify-self: center;\n      font-size: 3rem;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      margin: 0;\n      padding: 0;\n    }\n\n    &amp;__image {\n      opacity: 1;\n      grid-column: 1 / 2;\n      grid-row: 1 / 2;\n      z-index: var(--z-index-page-transition);\n      width: 100%;\n      height: 100%;\n      object-fit: cover;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .is-visible {\n    opacity: 1;\n    pointer-events: auto;\n  }\n\n  .is-hidden {\n    opacity: 0;\n  }\n\n  .hide-element {\n    animation: fade-out 1s ease forwards;\n  }\n\n  .show-element {\n    animation: fade-in 1s ease;\n  }\n\n  @keyframes fade-in {\n    from {\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n    to {\n      opacity: 1;\n    }\n  }\n\n  @keyframes fade-out {\n    from {\n      opacity: 1;\n    }\n    to {\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "- Preloads images before page display\n\n### PageRegistry (&#96;app/services/PageRegistry.js&#96;)\n- Registry of page classes (template → PageClass)\n- Tracks current page instance\n- Provides lookup methods\n\n### RouterResolver (&#96;app/services/RouterResolver.js&#96;)\n- Validates routes against SiteConfig\n- Normalizes route formats\n- Handles invalid routes (redirects, external links)\n- Returns RouteValidationResult objects\n\n### RouterHistory (&#96;app/services/RouterHistory.js&#96;)\n- Manages browser history state\n- Handles popstate events (back/forward)\n- Normalizes routes for history\n- Prevents duplicate history entries\n\n### AnimationsManager (&#96;app/animations/AnimationsManager.js&#96;)\n- Discovers animations via data-animation attributes\n- Creates animation instances from registry\n- Manages shared IntersectionObserver\n- Cleans up animations on page destroy\n\n### TransitionsManager (&#96;app/animations/TransitionsManager.js&#96;)\n- Manages page transition overlays\n- Preloads transition images\n- Updates transition templates from SiteConfig\n- Coordinates transition animations\n\n### SiteConfig (&#96;app/config/SiteConfig.js&#96;)\n- Central configuration for all routes\n- Maps templates to classes, URLs, and transitions\n- Single source of truth for route data\n\n### Page Base Class (&#96;app/pages/Page.js&#96;)\n- Base class for all pages\n- Implements lifecycle methods\n- Manages page elements and components\n- Handles page animations\n\n### Component Base Class (&#96;app/components/Component.js&#96;)\n- Base class for all components\n- Provides event management\n- Handles element selection\n- Lifecycle management\n\n## Configuration\n\n### SiteConfig Structure\n\nEach route in &#96;SiteConfig&#96; contains:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n{\n  template: \"section-1\",      // data-template attribute\n  class: \"View\",              // JavaScript class name\n  link: \"/section-1\",        // URL path\n  url: \"/pages/section-1.html\", // HTML file path\n  transition: {\n    image: \"...\",             // Transition image URL\n    copy: \"...\",              // Transition text\n    alt: \"...\"                // Image alt text\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update overlay image element\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      if (imageReady) {\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "class App {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize page transition handler\n   */\n  async createPageTransition() {\n    if (this.pageTransition) return;\n    \n    // Create and initialize TransitionsManager for preloading transition images\n    if (!this.transitionsManager) {\n      this.transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ \n        siteConfig: this.siteConfig \n      });\n      await this.transitionsManager.init();\n    }\n    \n    this.pageTransition = new MPAPageTransition({\n      siteConfig: this.siteConfig,\n      transitionsManager: this.transitionsManager\n    });\n    await this.pageTransition.initialize();\n  }\n}\n\nconst app = new App();\nwhenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n  app.init().catch\n\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  setupTransitionTemplates() {\n    let transitionTemplates = document.createDocumentFragment();\n\n    for (const [route, data] of Object.entries(this.siteConfig.settings)) {\n      let template = this.createTransitionTemplate(route, data);\n      transitionTemplates.appendChild(\n        new DOMParser()\n          .parseFromString(template, \"text/html\")\n          .querySelector(SELECTORS.TEMPLATE)\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Replace all children with the templates from the fragment\n    // Using spread operator to extract all children from the DocumentFragment\n    // This explicitly moves all template elements into the DOM\n    this.transitionTemplates.replaceChildren(...transitionTemplates.children);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a transition template HTML string for a given route\n   * @param {string} route - The route identifier (e.g., \"home\", \"section-1\")\n   * @param {Object} data - Route configuration data from siteConfig\n   * @param {Object} data.transition - Transition configuration\n   * @param {string} data.transition.copy - Text to display during transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.image - Image URL for the transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.alt - Alt text for the transition image\n   * @returns {string} HTML template string with transition markup\n   * \n   * Removed:\n   * &lt;p class=\"page-transition-overlay__copy\"&gt;${data.transition.copy}&lt;/p&gt;\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found. Transition animations may not work.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set up listeners after elements are found\n    this.setupListeners();\n\n    this.isPageNavigating =\n      this.sessionStorage.getItem(\"pageTransition\") === \"true\";\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      // Overlay should be visible (scaleY: 1, opacity: 1) when navigating to new page\n      // It will be hidden by hideTransition()\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        scaleY: 1,\n        opacity: 1,\n        transformOrigin: \"top\"\n      });\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      \n      // Restore transition data from sessionStorage before hiding\n      // This ensures visual continuity - overlay shows correct image when hiding\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Initial state: overlay hidden\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        scaleY: 0,\n        opacity: 0\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async show() {\n  // Step 1: Initialize scroll\n  if (!this.smoothScroll.enabled() &amp;&amp; !this.preloader) {\n    this.smoothScroll.create();\n    this.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, {immediate: true});\n  }\n  \n  // Step 2: Track analytics\n  this.trackPageView();\n  \n  // Step 3: Hide transition\n  await this.animation.GSAPHideTransition(this.transitionOverlay);\n  \n  // Step 4: Focus management\n  this.focusMainContent();\n}\n\n// Home.js - Must override entire method\nasync show() {\n  // ❌ Must duplicate all 4 steps\n  if (!this.smoothScroll.enabled() &amp;&amp; !this.preloader) {\n    this.smoothScroll.create();\n    this.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, {immediate: true});\n  }\n  this.trackPageView(); // ❌ Copy-paste\n  await this.animation.GSAPHideTransition(this.transitionOverlay); // ❌ Copy-paste\n  this.focusMainContent(); // ❌ Copy-paste\n  \n  // ✅ Only this is new\n  this.playWelcomeAnimation();\n}\n\n// Problem: If Page.show() changes, must update Home.show() too!\n// Problem: 10 lines of duplication\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**With Hooks (✅ Good):**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;js\n// Page.js - Provides hooks\nasync show() {\n  // Step 1: Initialize scroll\n  if (!this.smoothScroll.enabled() &amp;&amp; !this.preloader) {\n    this.smoothScroll.create();\n    this.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, {immediate: true});\n  }\n  \n  // Step 2: Track analytics\n  this.trackPageView();\n  \n  // ✅ Hook: Before transition\n  await this.onBeforeShow?.();\n  \n  // Step 3: Hide transition\n  await this.animation.GSAPHideTransition(this.transitionOverlay);\n  \n  // Step 4: Focus management\n  this.focusMainContent();\n  \n  // ✅ Hook: After everything\n  await this.onAfterShow?.();\n}\n\n// Home.js - Only defines what's needed\nexport class Home extends Page {\n  // ✅ Only 1 line - just the custom logic\n  async onAfterShow() {\n    this.playWelcomeAnimation();\n  }\n}\n\n// ✅ No duplication\n// ✅ Automatic updates\n// ✅ Clean and simple\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Pros and Cons: Overriding vs Hooks\n\n### Overriding (Current Pattern - If You Used It)\n\n**Pros:**\n- ✅ Full control - can change any part\n- ✅ Simple concept - just override method",

Removed `transitionCopy` while keeping image and alt text. Summary of changes:

## Changes Made

1. **`scripts/generate-static-pages.js`**: Added `transitionImage` and `transitionAlt` to template data (no `transitionCopy`), with fallback defaults.

2. **`views/partials/page-transition.html`**: Updated to use Nunjucks template variables `{{ transitionImage }}` and `{{ transitionAlt }}` with fallbacks.

3. **`app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js`**: Removed copy-related code:
   - Removed copy element update in `restoreTransitionData()`
   - Removed copy element update in `updateTransitionOverlay()`

4. **Plan file**: Updated to reflect that only image and alt text are used (no copy).

## Verification Checklist

- Run build: `bun run build` (or `bun run dev` for development)
- Check generated pages: Verify that `pages/*.html` files have correct transition image and alt attributes
- Test navigation: Click between pages and verify the transition overlay shows the correct image for each route
- Browser check: Inspect the overlay element to confirm it has the correct `src` and `alt` attributes per page

The transition overlay now uses only image and alt text, with no copy text element.

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize preloading strategy for transition images\n   * Uses requestIdleCallback when available, otherwise falls back to setTimeout\n   * Preloading happens during browser idle time to avoid blocking main thread\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  initializePreloading() {\n    // Preload during idle time\n    if (\"requestIdleCallback\" in window) {\n      requestIdleCallback(() =&gt; {\n        this.preloadAllTransitionImages();\n      });\n    } else {\n      // Fallback for browsers without requestIdleCallback\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        this.preloadAllTransitionImages();\n      }, 2000);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Extract all image elements from transition templates\n   * @returns {HTMLImageElement[]} Array of image elements with data-src attributes\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update overlay image element\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      if (imageReady) {\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      \n      // Update overlay image element\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        // Check if image is preloaded\n        if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(transitionData.image)) {\n          imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n        } else {\n          // Preload if not already loaded\n          const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n          tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', transitionData.image);\n          if (this.transitionsManager) {\n            await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n          } else {\n            await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n          }\n          imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n        }\n        \n        if (transitionData.alt) {\n          imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Clear sessionStorage after restoring\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error restoring transition data:', error);\n      // Clear corrupted data\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   */\n  async preloadSingleImage(imgElement) {\n    if (!imgElement || !imgElement.dataset.src) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const url = imgElement.dataset.src;\n\n    // Skip if already preloaded\n    if (this.isImagePreloaded(url)) {\n      return imgElement;\n    }\n\n    // Check if currently loading\n    if (this.loadingPromises.has(url)) {\n      return this.loadingPromises.get(url);\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.loadImage({\n        element: imgElement,\n        useDecode: true,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload image: ${url}&#96;, error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n}",

void\n   * @param {Function} options.onImageLoad - Callback fired per image: (imageElement, index) =&gt; void\n   * @param {boolean} options.excludePreloader - Exclude images inside .preloader (default: false)\n   * @param {boolean} options.useDecode - Use decode() for layout-ready images (default: true)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Router use case - simple wait\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({ images: 'img[data-src]' });\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Preloader use case - with progress tracking\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({\n   *   images: this.images,\n   *   excludePreloader: true,\n   *   onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n   *     this.updateProgress(loaded, total, percentage);\n   *   }\n   * });\n   */\n  async preloadImages({\n    images,\n    container = document,\n    onProgress,\n    onImageLoad,\n    excludePreloader = false,\n    useDecode = true,\n  } = {}) {\n    // Prepare and filter images\n    const imageElements = this.prepareImages(images, container, excludePreloader);\n    \n    if (imageElements.length === 0) {\n      return { loaded: 0, total: 0, images: [] };\n    }\n    \n    // Create progress tracker\n    const trackProgress = this.createProgressTracker(\n      imageElements.length,\n      onProgress,\n      onImageLoad\n    );\n    \n    // Load all images\n    const imagePromises = imageElements.map((element, index) =&gt; {\n      return this.loadImage({\n        element,\n        index,\n        useDecode,\n        onLoad: (img) =&gt; trackProgress(img, index)\n      });\n    });\n    \n    const results = await Promise.all(imagePromises);\n    \n    // Count successful loads (non-null results)\n    const loadedCount = results.filter(result =&gt; result !== null).length;\n    \n    return {\n      loaded: loadedCount,\n      total: imageElements.length,\n      images: imageElements\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single image with decode support and state management\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n  async loadImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n    // Handle already-loaded images (cached)\n    if (this.isImageLoaded(element)) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, useDecode, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    const dataSrc = element.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC);\n    if (!dataSrc) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, false, onLoad);\n    }\n\n    // Track URL for preloading\n    const url = dataSrc;\n    \n    // Check if already preloaded\n    if (this.isImagePreloaded(url)) {\n      // Image is cached, just set src and wait for load event\n      element.src = url;\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    }\n\n    // Check if currently loading\n    if (this.loadingPromises.has(url)) {\n      // Wait for existing load to complete\n      await this.loadingPromises.get(url);\n      element.src = url;\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    }\n\n    // Get appropriate loader strategy\n    const loader = this.getImageLoader(useDecode, element);\n    \n    // Create loading promise and track it\n    const loadPromise = loader({ element, dataSrc, useDecode, onLoad })\n      .then((result) =&gt; {\n        // Mark as preloaded on success\n        if (result) {\n          this.preloadedUrls.add(url);\n        }\n        this.loadingPromises.delete(url);\n        return result;\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        this.loadingPromises.delete(url);\n        throw error;\n      });\n    \n    this.loadingPromises.set(url, loadPromise);\n    \n    return loadPromise;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload multiple images with support for progress tracking and decoding\n   * \n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement[]|NodeList|string} options.images - Array of image elements, NodeList, or CSS selector\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} options.container - Container to search in (default: document)\n   * @param {Function} options.onProgress - Callback fired when each image loads: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; void\n   * @param {Function} options.onImageLoad - Callback fired per image: (imageElement, index) =&gt; void\n   * @param {boolean} options.excludePreloader - Exclude images inside .preloader (default: false)\n   * @param {boolean} options.useDecode - Use decode() for layout-ready images (default: true)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Router use case - simple wait\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({ images: 'img[data-src]' });\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Preloader use case - with progress tracking\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({\n   *   images: this.images,\n   *   excludePreloader: true,\n   *   onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n   *     this.updateProgress(loaded, total, percentage);\n   *   }\n   * });\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load all page images including navigation overlay background\n   * Uses ImageService to load all images with data-src attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   */\n  async loadPageImages() {\n    try {\n      await this.imageService.preloadImages({\n        images: 'img[data-src]',\n        excludePreloader: true,\n        useDecode: true,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error loading page images:', error);\n      // Continue even if image loading fails\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Store transition data in sessionStorage for persistence across page loads\n   * @param {Object} transitionData - Transition data object with image, alt, copy\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * Uses ImageService for consistent behavior\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   * @example\n   * const img = document.querySelector('img[data-src]');\n   * await transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(img);\n   */\n  async preloadSingleImage(imgElement) {\n    if (!imgElement || !imgElement.dataset.src) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      return await this.imageLoader.preloadSingleImage(imgElement);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(\n        &#96;Failed to preload transition image: ${imgElement.dataset.src}&#96;,\n        error\n      );\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/pre-generate_transition_overlay_markup_at_build_time_f3eae7ec.plan.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "---\nname: \"\"\noverview: \"\"\ntodos: []\nisProject: false\n---\n\n## Problem Analysis\n\n**Current Issue**: Flash of new page content before transition overlay markup is updated via JavaScript, causing visual glitches.\n\n**Root Cause**: In MPA, each page loads fresh HTML. The overlay markup is static (hardcoded in partial), then JavaScript tries to update it after page load, creating a race condition.\n\n**Solution**: Pre-generate the correct transition overlay markup for each page during build time, so the HTML already contains the right image and alt text when the page loads.\n\n## Benefits of Build-Time Approach\n\n1. **No Race Conditions**: Markup is correct from the start\n2. **No Flash**: Overlay has correct content immediately\n3. **Simpler Runtime Code**: No DOM manipulation needed for markup\n4. **Better Performance**: No JavaScript needed to update overlay content\n5. **More Reliable**: Works even if JavaScript fails or is slow\n6. **MPA-Optimized**: Each page is self-contained with correct markup\n\n## Implementation Steps\n\n### Step 1: Add Transition Data to Template Data\n\n**File**: &#96;scripts/generate-static-pages.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- In the loop where &#96;templateData&#96; is built, add transition data from &#96;routeConfig.transition&#96;\n- Pass &#96;transitionImage&#96; and &#96;transitionAlt&#96; to template (no copy text)\n- Handle case where route doesn't have transition data (fallback to defaults)\n\n**Code location**: Around line 210-228 where &#96;templateData&#96; is populated\n\n### Step 2: Update page-transition.html Partial\n\n**File**: &#96;views/partials/page-transition.html&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- Replace hardcoded image &#96;src&#96; with &#96;{{ transitionImage }}&#96; or fallback\n- Replace hardcoded &#96;alt&#96; with &#96;{{ transitionAlt }}&#96; or fallback\n- Use Nunjucks conditionals to handle missing data gracefully\n\n**Current hardcoded values**:\n\n- Image: &#96;\"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp\"&#96;\n- Alt: &#96;\"The Shea Memorandum Logo\"&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Simplify MPAPageTransition.js\n\n**File**: &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        },
        "contents": "export class Preloader extends Component {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Wait for images to load and then update the DOM with the path\n   */\n  async createLoader() {\n    // If no images to load, wait for background image and complete\n    if (this.images.length === 0) {\n      await this.startPreloaderAnimation();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Preload page images using ImageService\n    const pageImagesPromise = this.imageLoader.preloadImages({\n      images: this.images,\n      excludePreloader: false,\n      useDecode: true,\n      onProgress: (imagesLoaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n        this.imagesLoaded = imagesLoaded;\n        this.percentage = percentage;\n       \n        // Update the counter element if it exists\n        if (this.elements.counter) {\n          this.elements.counter.innerHTML = &#96;${percentage}%&#96;;\n        }\n      }\n    }).catch((error) =&gt; {\n      console.error('Error preloading images:', error);\n      // Return empty result to prevent hanging\n      return { loaded: 0, total: 0, images: [] };\n    });\n\n    // Wait for images to complete\n    const pageImagesResult = await pageImagesPromise;\n\n    // Check if all images loaded and the animation hasn't started yet\n    if (pageImagesResult &amp;&amp; pageImagesResult.loaded === pageImagesResult.total &amp;&amp; !this.animationStarted) {\n      await this.startPreloaderAnimation();\n    }\n  }\n  \n\n  /**\n   * Play the preloader animation\n   * Delegates to PreloaderAnimation class for animation logic\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "class App {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize page transition handler\n   */\n  async createPageTransition() {\n    if (this.pageTransition) return;\n    \n    // Create and initialize TransitionsManager for preloading transition images\n    if (!this.transitionsManager) {\n      this.transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ \n        siteConfig: this.siteConfig \n      });\n      await this.transitionsManager.init();\n    }\n    \n    this.pageTransition = new MPAPageTransition({\n      siteConfig: this.siteConfig,\n      transitionsManager: this.transitionsManager\n    });\n    await this.pageTransition.initialize();\n  }\n}\n\nconst app = new App();\nwhenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n  app.init().catch\n\n}",

        "contents": "# Image Preloading Utilities Documentation\n\n## Introduction\n\nThe &#96;Images.js&#96; module provides a comprehensive set of utilities for image preloading, lazy loading, and decode support. It's designed to handle various image loading scenarios with support for progress tracking, decode-before-DOM strategies, and flexible input types.\n\n### Key Features\n\n- **Decode-before-DOM**: Prevents flicker by decoding images off-DOM before setting them on DOM elements\n- **Progress Tracking**: Built-in support for progress callbacks during batch loading\n- **Flexible Input Types**: Accepts CSS selectors, arrays, NodeLists, or single elements\n- **Smart Caching**: Automatically detects and skips already-loaded images\n- **Error Handling**: Graceful error handling that doesn't break batch operations\n- **Composable Design**: Functions can be combined for custom loading strategies\n\n### Module Structure\n\nThe module exports both high-level batch loading functions and low-level utilities that can be composed for custom use cases. All functions are designed to work together seamlessly.\n\n---\n\n## Public API Functions\n\n### &#96;preloadImages(options)&#96;\n\nMain entry point for batch image preloading. Handles multiple images in parallel with optional progress tracking.\n\n**Signature:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nasync function preloadImages({\n  images,\n  container = document,\n  onProgress,\n  onImageLoad,\n  excludePreloader = false,\n  useDecode = true,\n} = {})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Returns:** &#96;Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;&#96;\n\n**Parameters:**\n- &#96;images&#96; - Array of image elements, NodeList, CSS selector string, or single element\n- &#96;container&#96; - Container to search in (default: &#96;document&#96;)\n- &#96;onProgress&#96; - Callback: &#96;(loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; void&#96;\n- &#96;onImageLoad&#96; - Callback: &#96;(imageElement, index) =&gt; void&#96;\n- &#96;excludePreloader&#96; - Exclude images inside &#96;.preloader&#96; (default: &#96;false&#96;)\n- &#96;useDecode&#96; - Use &#96;decode()&#96; for layout-ready images (default: &#96;true&#96;)\n\n**Use Cases:**\n\n1. **Page Manager - Wait for page images** (&#96;PageManager.js&#96;):\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nasync waitForPageReady() {\n  ",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

          {
            "lineNumber": 4

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nconstructor({ siteConfig }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n  async init() {\n    // Helper function to perform initialization\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      whenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n        this.pageTransition = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_OVERLAY);\n        this.transitionTemplates = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_TEMPLATES);\n\n        this.setupTransitionTemplates();\n        this.initializePreloading();\n        resolve();\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nimport { MyCustomAnimation } from \"./MyCustomAnimation.js\";\n\nexport class AnimationsManager {\n  constructor() {\n    this.animationRegistry = {\n      title: Titles,\n      'my-custom': MyCustomAnimation,  // Add your animation\n    };\n    // ...\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Step 3: Use in HTML\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n&lt;div data-animation=\"my-custom\"&gt;\n  This will animate with MyCustomAnimation\n&lt;/div&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Registering Custom Animations at Runtime\n\nYou can also register GSAP timelines directly:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// In your Page class\nasync create() {\n  await super.create();\n  \n  const customTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n    paused: true,\n    onComplete: () =&gt; {\n      // Animation complete\n    }\n  });\n  \n  customTimeline.to(this.elements.someElement, {\n    opacity: 1,\n    duration: 1\n  });\n  \n  // Register with AnimationsManager\n  this.animationsManager.register(customTimeline);\n  \n  // Play when ready\n  customTimeline.play();\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Important:** Registered animations are automatically cleaned up when the page is destroyed.\n\n## Image Preloading\n\nThe application provides a robust image preloading system with decode support to prevent layout shifts and flicker.\n\n### Basic Usage\n\n#### Lazy Loading with data-src\n\nUse &#96;data-src&#96; instead of &#96;src&#96; for images that should be preloaded:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n&lt;img \n  data-src=\"https://example.com/image.jpg\" \n  alt=\"Description\"\n/&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe &#96;PageManager&#96; automatically preloads all &#96;img[data-src]&#96; elements before showing the page.\n\n#### Excluding Preloader Images\n\nImages inside &#96;.preloader&#96; are automatically excluded from page preloading.\n\n### Using preloadImages Utility\n\n#### Basic Preloading\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nimport { preloadImages } from \"../utilities/Images.js\";\n\n// Preload all images with data-src\nawait preloadImages({\n  images: 'img[data-src]',\n  container: document,\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### With Progress Tracking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nawait preloadImages({\n  images: this.images,\n  excludePreloader: true,",

        "contents": "**Dependencies:** &#96;loadPage()&#96;\n\n### 9. TransitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay() - Template Loading\n\n**File:** &#96;app/animations/TransitionsManager.js:227-265&#96;\n**Issue:** Image preloading not cancellable. DOM updates happen even if navigation cancelled.\n**Impact:**\n\n- MEDIUM: Unnecessary image preloading\n- DOM manipulation for cancelled navigation\n**Priority:** MEDIUM\n**Lines affected:** ~39 lines\n**Dependencies:** &#96;preloadSingleImage()&#96;, DOM operations\n\n### 10. PageTransition.showPageTransition() - GSAP Animation\n\n**File:** &#96;app/animations/PageTransition.js:9-42&#96;\n**Issue:** GSAP timeline not cancellable. Animation continues even if navigation cancelled.\n**Impact:**\n\n- MEDIUM: Animation conflicts during rapid navigation\n- Timeline not cleaned up on abort\n- Promise never resolves if aborted\n**Priority:** MEDIUM\n**Lines affected:** ~34 lines\n**Dependencies:** GSAP\n\n### 11. PageTransition.hidePageTransition() - GSAP Animation\n\n**File:** &#96;app/animations/PageTransition.js:44-96&#96;\n**Issue:** GSAP timeline not cancellable. Same issues as showPageTransition.\n**Impact:**\n\n- MEDIUM: Animation conflicts\n- Timeline cleanup missing\n**Priority:** MEDIUM\n**Lines affected:** ~53 lines\n**Dependencies:** GSAP\n\n### 12. PageManager.waitForPageReady() - Image Preloading\n\n**File:** &#96;app/services/PageManager.js:137-147&#96;\n**Issue:** &#96;preloadImages()&#96; called without signal. Images continue loading for cancelled navigation.\n**Impact:**\n\n- MEDIUM: Network waste\n- Layout calculations for wrong page\n**Priority:** MEDIUM\n**Lines affected:** ~11 lines\n**Dependencies:** &#96;preloadImages()&#96; utility\n\n### 13. TransitionsManager.preloadSingleImage() - Image Loading\n\n**File:** &#96;app/animations/TransitionsManager.js:190-214&#96;\n**Issue:** Calls &#96;preloadImages()&#96; without signal. Single image preloading not cancellable.\n**Impact:**\n\n- LOW: Single image, less critical\n- Still wasteful if navigation cancelled\n**Priority:** LOW\n**Lines affected:** ~25 lines\n**Dependencies:** &#96;preloadImages()&#96; utility\n\n---\n\n## S (Small) - Utility Enhancements\n\n### 14. Images.js preloadImages() - Batch Image Loading\n\n**File:** &#96;app/utilities/Images.js:341-383&#96;",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update overlay image element\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      if (imageReady) {\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      \n      // Update overlay image element\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        // Check if image is preloaded\n        if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(transitionData.image)) {\n          imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n        } else {\n          // Preload if not already loaded\n          const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n          tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', transitionData.image);\n          if (this.transitionsManager) {\n            await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n          } else {\n            await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n          }\n          imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n        }\n        \n        if (transitionData.alt) {\n          imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // Clear sessionStorage after restoring\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error restoring transition data:', error);\n      // Clear corrupted data\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found. Transition animations may not work.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set up listeners after elements are found\n    this.setupListeners();\n\n    this.isPageNavigating =\n      this.sessionStorage.getItem(\"pageTransition\") === \"true\";\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      // Overlay should be visible (scaleY: 1, opacity: 1) when navigating to new page\n      // It will be hidden by hideTransition()\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        scaleY: 1,\n        opacity: 1,\n        transformOrigin: \"top\"\n      });\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      \n      // Restore transition data from sessionStorage before hiding\n      // This ensures visual continuity - overlay shows correct image when hiding\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Initial state: overlay hidden\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        scaleY: 0,\n        opacity: 0\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { ImageService } from \"../utilities/ImageService.js\";\nimport { whenDOMReady } from \"../utilities/AsyncHelpers.js\";\nimport { $ } from \"../utilities/DOMHelpers.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\n\n/**\n * TransitionsManager class for managing the transition overlay\n * Handles the transition overlay templates and preloading of images\n * Manages the transition overlay elements\n */\nexport class TransitionsManager {\n  /**\n   * Creates a new TransitionsManager instance\n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {import(\"../config/SiteConfig.js\").SiteConfig} options.siteConfig - Site configuration containing route and transition data\n   */\n  constructor({ siteConfig }) {\n    this.siteConfig = siteConfig;\n    this.imageLoader = new ImageService();\n    this.pageTransition = null;\n    this.transitionTemplates = null;\n    this.transitionAnimations = new PageTransition();\n    // * Note: Don't call init() here - let App call it when DOM is ready\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nconstructor({ siteConfig }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n  async init() {\n    // Helper function to perform initialization\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      whenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n        this.pageTransition = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_OVERLAY);\n        this.transitionTemplates = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_TEMPLATES);\n\n        this.setupTransitionTemplates();\n        this.initializePreloading();\n        resolve();\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Link transitions that animate between pages\n */\nexport class PageTransition {\n  constructor() {\n    this.timelines = [];\n  }\n\n  async showPageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const transitionTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      transitionTimeline\n        .to(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          duration: 1.25,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        })\n        .set(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          delay: .5,\n        });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async hidePageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const hideTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      // ✅ CRITICAL: Animate the main element FIRST at position 0\n      // This ensures it always animates even if child elements don't exist\n      hideTimeline.to(\n        element,\n        {\n          opacity: 0,\n          duration: 1,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        },\n        0\n      ); // Position 0 = start immediately\n    });\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/pre-generate_transition_overlay_markup_at_build_time_f3eae7ec.plan.md",
        "range": {

        },
        "contents": "---\nname: \"\"\noverview: \"\"\ntodos: []\nisProject: false\n---\n\n## Problem Analysis\n\n**Current Issue**: Flash of new page content before transition overlay markup is updated via JavaScript, causing visual glitches.\n\n**Root Cause**: In MPA, each page loads fresh HTML. The overlay markup is static (hardcoded in partial), then JavaScript tries to update it after page load, creating a race condition.\n\n**Solution**: Pre-generate the correct transition overlay markup for each page during build time, so the HTML already contains the right image and alt text when the page loads.\n\n## Benefits of Build-Time Approach\n\n1. **No Race Conditions**: Markup is correct from the start\n2. **No Flash**: Overlay has correct content immediately\n3. **Simpler Runtime Code**: No DOM manipulation needed for markup\n4. **Better Performance**: No JavaScript needed to update overlay content\n5. **More Reliable**: Works even if JavaScript fails or is slow\n6. **MPA-Optimized**: Each page is self-contained with correct markup\n\n## Implementation Steps\n\n### Step 1: Add Transition Data to Template Data\n\n**File**: &#96;scripts/generate-static-pages.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- In the loop where &#96;templateData&#96; is built, add transition data from &#96;routeConfig.transition&#96;\n- Pass &#96;transitionImage&#96; and &#96;transitionAlt&#96; to template (no copy text)\n- Handle case where route doesn't have transition data (fallback to defaults)\n\n**Code location**: Around line 210-228 where &#96;templateData&#96; is populated\n\n### Step 2: Update page-transition.html Partial\n\n**File**: &#96;views/partials/page-transition.html&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- Replace hardcoded image &#96;src&#96; with &#96;{{ transitionImage }}&#96; or fallback\n- Replace hardcoded &#96;alt&#96; with &#96;{{ transitionAlt }}&#96; or fallback\n- Use Nunjucks conditionals to handle missing data gracefully\n\n**Current hardcoded values**:\n\n- Image: &#96;\"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp\"&#96;\n- Alt: &#96;\"The Shea Memorandum Logo\"&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Simplify MPAPageTransition.js\n\n**File**: &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": "name: \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 2

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\nconst imageElement = ('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      if (imageReady) {\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      } else {\n        // Set src anyway - browser will load it\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      }\n      \n      if (transitionData.alt) {\n        imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Wait for image to be ready if element exists\n    if (imageElement) {\n      try {\n        await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageElement);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('Error waiting for transition image load:', error);\n        // Continue anyway\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap)\n  }\n}",
