        "contents": "**File**: &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- Remove &#96;updateTransitionOverlay()&#96; method (no longer needed)\n- Remove &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; method (no longer needed)\n- Remove &#96;storeTransitionData()&#96; method (no longer needed)\n- Keep &#96;normalizeHrefToRoute()&#96; (still needed for route lookup)\n- Keep animation methods (&#96;showTransition()&#96;, &#96;hideTransition()&#96;)\n- Simplify &#96;setupListeners()&#96; - remove overlay update logic, just show transition and navigate\n- Simplify &#96;initialize()&#96; - remove restore logic, just handle hide animation\n\n**Result**: MPAPageTransition becomes a pure animation controller, not a markup updater.\n\n### Step 4: Update initialize() Logic\n\n**File**: &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\n**Changes**:\n\n- When &#96;isPageNavigating&#96; is true, the overlay already has correct markup from HTML\n- Just need to ensure it's visible (&#96;scaleY: 1, opacity: 1&#96;) before hiding\n- Remove all &#96;restoreTransitionData()&#96; calls\n\n## Implementation Details\n\n### generate-static-pages.js Changes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nif (routeKey) {\n  const routeConfig = siteConfig.get(routeKey);\n  if (routeConfig) {\n    // ... existing code ...\n    \n    // Add transition data for overlay (image and alt only, no copy)\n    if (routeConfig.transition) {\n      templateData.transitionImage = routeConfig.transition.image;\n      templateData.transitionAlt = routeConfig.transition.alt;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Fallback defaults if no transition data\nif (!templateData.transitionImage) {\n  templateData.transitionImage = \"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp\";\n  templateData.transitionAlt = \"The Shea Memorandum Logo\";\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### page-transition.html Changes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n&lt;section class=\"page-transition-overlay\"&gt;\n  &lt;img\n    class=\"page-transition-overlay__image\"\n    src=\"{{ transitionImage or 'https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp' }}\"\n    alt=\"{{ transitionAlt or 'The Shea Memorandum Logo' }}\"\n  /&gt;\n&lt;/section&gt;\n\n&lt;section id=\"page-transition-overlay-templates\"&gt;&lt;/section&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "await preloadImages({\n  images: this.images,\n  excludePreloader: true,\n  useDecode: true,  // Decode images for layout-ready rendering\n  onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n    console.log(&#96;${percentage}% loaded&#96;);\n    // Update progress bar, etc.\n  },\n  onImageLoad: (imageElement, index) =&gt; {\n    // Called when each image loads\n    console.log(&#96;Image ${index} loaded:&#96;, imageElement);\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Preloading Specific Images\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Preload specific image elements\nconst images = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery img[data-src]');\nawait preloadImages({\n  images: images,\n  useDecode: true,\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Preloading Single Image\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nimport { loadSingleImage } from \"../utilities/Images.js\";\n\nconst img = document.querySelector('img[data-src]');\nawait loadSingleImage({\n  element: img,\n  useDecode: true,\n  onLoad: (loadedImg) =&gt; {\n    console.log('Image loaded:', loadedImg);\n  }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Image Decode Support\n\nThe &#96;useDecode: true&#96; option:\n- Loads images off-DOM first\n- Decodes them before setting &#96;src&#96; {\n        // Update gallery loading state\n      }\n    });\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Page Transitions\n\nPage transitions provide smooth visual feedback when navigating between pages.\n\n### Configuration\n\nTransitions are configured in &#96;SiteConfig&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n'my-page': {\n  // ... other config\n  transition: {\n    image: \"https://example.com/transition-image.jpg\",\n    copy: \"Loading My Page...\",\n    alt: \"Transition image description\"\n  },\n},\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### How Transitions Work\n\n1. **On Page Hide**: \n   ",

        "contents": "@layer components {\n  .page-transition-overlay {\n    inset: 0;\n    opacity: 0;\n    pointer-events: none;\n    position: fixed;\n    z-index: var(--z-index-page-transition);\n    display: grid;\n    grid-template-columns: 1fr;\n    grid-template-rows: 1fr;\n    justify-content: center;\n    align-items: center;\n    will-change: opacity; /* Hint to browser for GPU acceleration */\n    background-color: var(--color-white);\n\n    &amp;__copy {\n      opacity: 0;\n      color: black;\n      grid-column: 1 / 2;\n      grid-row: 1 / 2;\n      z-index: var(--z-index-page-transition-copy);\n      text-align: center;\n      justify-self: center;\n      font-size: 3rem;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      margin: 0;\n      padding: 0;\n    }\n\n    &amp;__image {\n      opacity: 1;\n      grid-column: 1 / 2;\n      grid-row: 1 / 2;\n      z-index: var(--z-index-page-transition);\n      width: 100%;\n      height: 100%;\n      object-fit: cover;\n    }\n  }\n\n  .is-visible {\n    opacity: 1;\n    pointer-events: auto;\n  }\n\n  .is-hidden {\n    opacity: 0;\n  }\n\n  .hide-element {\n    animation: fade-out 1s ease forwards;\n  }\n\n  .show-element {\n    animation: fade-in 1s ease;\n  }\n\n  @keyframes fade-in {\n    from {\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n    to {\n      opacity: 1;\n    }\n  }\n\n  @keyframes fade-out {\n    from {\n      opacity: 1;\n    }\n    to {\n      opacity: 0;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "async function generateStaticPages() {\n\n\n  for await (const file of glob.scan(viewsPagesDir.pathname)) {\n    try {\n      // Determine output path\n      let outputPath;\n      if (file === \"index.html\") {\n        outputPath = &#96;${outputDir.pathname}index.html&#96;;\n      } else {\n        outputPath = &#96;${outputDir.pathname}${file}&#96;;\n      }\n\n      // Ensure output directory exists\n      const outputDirPath = outputPath.substring(\n        0,\n        outputPath.lastIndexOf(\"/\")\n      );\n      await mkdir(outputDirPath, { recursive: true });\n\n      // Get route key and formatted title from SiteConfig\n      const routeKey = getRouteKeyFromFilename(file);\n      let templateData = { ...currentPaths };\n      \n      // Add base URL for all templates\n      templateData.baseUrl = baseUrl;\n      \n      if (routeKey) {\n        const routeConfig = siteConfig.get(routeKey);\n        if (routeConfig) {\n          if (routeConfig.title) {\n            templateData.pageTitle = formatPageTitle(routeKey, routeConfig.title);\n          }\n          if (routeConfig.metaDescription) {\n            templateData.metaDescription = routeConfig.metaDescription;\n          }\n          // Use 'link' property for canonical URL (clean route, not file path)\n          // 'link' is the canonical path like \"/\" or \"/section-1\"\n          // 'url' is the file path like \"/pages/index.html\"\n          if (routeConfig.link) {\n            templateData.canonicalPath = routeConfig.link;\n          }\n          // Add transition data for overlay (image and alt only, no copy)\n          if (routeConfig.transition) {\n            templateData.transitionImage = routeConfig.transition.image;\n            templateData.transitionAlt = routeConfig.transition.alt;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // Fallback defaults if no transition data\n      if (!templateData.transitionImage) {\n        templateData.transitionImage = \"https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp\";\n        templateData.transitionAlt = \"The Shea Memorandum Logo\";\n      }\n      // Add page-specific inline script (use routeKey or null for fallback)\n      templateData.pageScript = getPageInitScript(routeKey, isProduction);\n}",

The issue: images are preloaded off-DOM, but when a new page loads with `<img src="...">`, the browser may re-request before using cache, causing a brief flash.

Proposing a solution that combines:
1. HTML `<link rel="preload">` for the current page’s transition image
2. Early cache check in `MPAPageTransition.initialize()` to set `src` immediately if cached

Creating the plan:

{
  "plan": "# Cache Transition Images to Prevent Flash\n\n## Problem\n\nWhen navigating to a new page or refreshing, the transition overlay image is re-requested even though it was preloaded, causing a brief flash/white page. The browser cache should be used, but there's a timing issue where the browser doesn't immediately recognize the cached image.\n\n## Root Cause\n\n1. Images are preloaded off-DOM via &#96;TransitionsManager.preloadAllTransitionImages()&#96;\n2. When a new page loads, HTML contains &#96;&lt;img src=\"...\"&gt;&#96; with the transition image URL\n3. Browser parses HTML and may make a new request before checking cache, causing flash\n4. Even though image is in browser cache, there's a brief moment where browser checks/loads\n\n## Solution\n\nUse a two-pronged approach:\n\n1. **HTML Preload Links**: Add &#96;&lt;link rel=\"preload\" as=\"image\"&gt;&#96; in the HTML head for the current page's transition image\n2. **Early Cache Check**: In &#96;MPAPageTransition.initialize()&#96;, immediately check if the image is cached and set &#96;src&#96; synchronously\n\n## Implementation\n\n### Step 1: Add Preload Links to Generated HTML\n\n**File**: &#96;scripts/generate-static-pages.js&#96;\n\nAdd transition image preload link to the template data, then include it in the HTML head via a new partial or inline in the head section.\n\n**Changes**:\n- After setting &#96;templateData.transitionImage&#96;, add &#96;templateData.transitionPreloadLink&#96; \n- Generate &#96;&lt;link rel=\"preload\" as=\"image\" href=\"{{ transitionImage }}\"&gt;&#96; HTML string\n- Pass to template (need to check where head partial is or add inline)\n\n**Location**: Around line 225-230 where transition data is added\n\n### Step 2: Add Preload Link to HTML Head\n\n**File**: &#96;views/partials/seo.html&#96; or wherever head meta tags are\n\nAdd the preload link in the HTML head section. If no head partial exists, we'll need to add it to the page layout.\n\n**Alternative**: Add directly in &#96;views/layouts/page.html&#96; head section if that's where head content lives\n\n### Step 3: Early Cache Check in MPAPageTransition.initialize()\n\n**File**: &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\nIn &#96;initialize()&#96;, immediately after getting the transition overlay element, check if the image is already cached and set &#96;src&#96; synchronously.\n\n**Changes**:\n- After line 179 where &#96;transitionOverlay&#96; is found\n- Get the current image element and its &#96;src&#96; attribute\n- Check if image is already loaded/cached using &#96;ImageService.isImagePreloaded()&#96; or browser cache check\n- If cached, set &#96;src&#96; immediately (should be instant from cache)\n- This happens before any animations, ensuring image is ready\n\n**Code location**: Around line 179-189 in &#96;initialize()&#96; method\n\n### Step 4: Browser Cache Check Helper\n\n**File**: &#96;app/utilities/ImageService.js&#96; or &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96;\n\nAdd a helper method to check if an image URL is in browser cache by creating a test image and checking &#96;complete&#96; property.\n\n**Method**: &#96;isImageInBrowserCache(url)&#96; - returns Promise&lt;boolean&gt;\n\n## Technical Details\n\n### Preload Link Format\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n&lt;link rel=\"preload\" as=\"image\" href=\"{{ transitionImage }}\" crossorigin=\"anonymous\"&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe &#96;crossorigin&#96; attribute may be needed if images are from CDN.\n\n### Cache Check Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// In initialize(), after getting transitionOverlay element\nconst imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\nif (imageElement &amp;&amp; imageElement.src) {\n  // Check if image is already cached\n  const img = new Image();\n  img.src = imageElement.src;\n  if (img.complete) {\n    // Image is cached, already loaded\n    // No need to change src, browser will use cache\n  } else {\n    // Image not cached, but preload link should have loaded it\n    // Wait for load event\n    await new Promise(resolve =&gt; {\n      img.onload = resolve;\n      img.onerror = resolve; // Continue even on error\n    });\n  }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Alternative: Use ImageService Cache Check\n\nSince &#96;ImageService&#96; already tracks preloaded URLs, we can check:\n- If URL is in &#96;transitionsManager.imageLoader.preloadedUrls&#96;, image is cached\n- Set &#96;src&#96; immediately - browser will use cache\n\n## Files to Modify\n\n1. &#96;scripts/generate-static-pages.js&#96; - Add transition preload link to template data\n2. &#96;views/partials/seo.html&#96; or &#96;views/layouts/page.html&#96; - Add preload link in head\n3. &#96;app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js&#96; - Add early cache check in &#96;initialize()&#96;\n\n## Benefits\n\n1. **HTML Preload**: Browser starts loading image before parsing &#96;&lt;img&gt;&#96; tag\n2. **Early Cache Check**: JavaScript ensures cached image is used immediately\n3. **No Flash**: Image loads instantly from cache when page loads\n4. **Backward Compatible**: Falls back gracefully if cache check fails\n\n## Edge Cases\n\n- Image not yet cached: Preload link ensures it starts loading early\n- Browser cache cleared: Preload link + normal loading handles it\n- Network slow: Preload link gives head start, reduces flash duration\n- Image fails to load: Normal error handling applies\n\n## Verification\n\n- Check Network tab: Transition image should show \"from cache\" or \"from memory cache\"\n- No flash: Transition overlay should appear instantly with correct image\n- Navigation: Smooth transitions between pages without white flash",

## Implementation Summary

### Step 1: Added Preload Link to Template Data
- Modified `scripts/generate-static-pages.js` to generate a `<link rel="preload">` tag for each page's transition image
- The preload link is added to `templateData.transitionPreloadLink` after setting the transition image

### Step 2: Added Preload Link to HTML Head
- Modified `views/partials/seo.html` to include the preload link in the HTML head section
- The link is placed early in the head, before other resources, so the browser starts loading the image immediately

### Step 3: Added Early Cache Check
- Modified `app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js` in the `initialize()` method
- Added a cache check that:
  - Verifies if the image is already loaded/cached using the `complete` property
  - Checks if the image is tracked as preloaded in `ImageService`
  - Forces a cache check by resetting the `src` attribute if the image is preloaded

## How It Works

1. HTML preload link: The browser starts loading the transition image before parsing the `<img>` tag
2. HTML src attribute: The image `src` is already set in the HTML from build-time generation
3. Cache check: JavaScript verifies the image is cached and ensures the browser uses the cached version
4. Result: The image loads instantly from cache, eliminating the flash

## Verification Steps

To test the implementation:

1. Build the pages: `bun run build` (or `bun run dev` for development)
2. Check Network tab: The transition image should show "from cache" or "from memory cache"
3. Navigate between pages: Click links and verify smooth transitions without white flash
4. Refresh pages: Hard refresh (Cmd+Shift+R) and verify no flash on page load

The implementation is complete and ready for testing. The combination of HTML preload links and early cache checking should eliminate the flash when navigating or refreshing pages.

Fixed the crossorigin mismatch. The preload link uses `crossorigin="anonymous"`, but the image elements and Image() objects didn't, so the browser ignored the preload.

## Changes Made

1. **Added `crossorigin="anonymous"` to the `<img>` tag** in `views/partials/page-transition.html`
2. **Added `crossOrigin = 'anonymous'` to Image() objects** in `app/utilities/ImageService.js` (`loadImageOffDOM()`)
3. **Added `crossOrigin = 'anonymous'` to all temporary image elements** created in `MPAPageTransition`:
   - In `restoreTransitionData()` 
   - In `updateTransitionOverlay()`
4. **Added `crossOrigin = 'anonymous'` to the image element** when updating src in:
   - `restoreTransitionData()`
   - `updateTransitionOverlay()`
   - Early cache check in `initialize()`

All image loading now matches the preload link's `crossorigin="anonymous"`, so the browser will use the preloaded resource and eliminate the flash.

## Verification

After rebuilding (`bun run build`), you should see:
- No more crossorigin mismatch warnings in the console
- The preload resource being used (check Network tab - should show "from cache")
- No white flash when navigating or refreshing pages

The images should now load instantly from the browser cache.

Analyzing the logs:

- Hypothesis A: REJECTED — early cache check doesn't clear src (image is complete).
- Hypothesis B: CONFIRMED — `restoreTransitionData()` runs after the overlay is visible (line 20 sets visible, line 22 starts restore). Even though the image is complete (`complete:true`), `isPreloaded` is false (line 25), causing unnecessary preloading and a src reset (line 27), which can cause a flash.
- Hypothesis C: REJECTED — `updateTransitionOverlay()` waits for the image before showing.
- Hypothesis D: INCONCLUSIVE — multiple src assignments occur, but timing is the issue.
- Hypothesis E: REJECTED — sessionStorage has data.

Root cause: `restoreTransitionData()` runs after the overlay is visible and unnecessarily preloads/resets src even when the image is already complete, causing a flash.

Fix: Skip `restoreTransitionData()` when the image is already complete and matches the expected src, or run it before making the overlay visible.

Fix: Even if `complete:true`, the image may not be painted when the overlay becomes visible. Added a forced repaint before showing the overlay:

1. Force layout calculation by reading `offsetHeight`
2. Wait for the next animation frame to ensure paint completes

This ensures the image is rendered before the overlay becomes visible, preventing the flash on unvisited pages.

<reproduction_steps>
1. Start the dev server if not running: `bun run dev`
2. Clear browser cache or use incognito mode to simulate unvisited pages
3. Navigate to section-7 and section-8 (the pages that were flashing)
4. Pay attention to whether the flash still occurs
5. Navigate to other unvisited pages to verify the fix works consistently
6. After testing, confirm if the flash is gone
</reproduction_steps>

The fix forces the browser to paint the image before the overlay becomes visible, eliminating the flash even when the image data is loaded but not yet painted.

## Summary

The flash was caused by `restoreTransitionData()` overwriting the correct HTML image with stale sessionStorage data from a previous page.

**Why it was inconsistent:**
- Visiting `/references` or `/introduction` (which use `home-theme-desktop.webp`) stored that image in sessionStorage
- Navigating to `/section-3`, `/section-5`, or `/section-6` (which have their own images) caused `restoreTransitionData()` to overwrite the correct HTML image with the stale `home-theme-desktop.webp` from sessionStorage
- This caused a brief flash of the wrong image

**The fix:**
- Updated `restoreTransitionData()` to check if the HTML already has a valid, non-fallback image
- If the HTML image is valid and doesn't match sessionStorage, skip restoring (trust the HTML)
- Only restore from sessionStorage if the HTML image is missing/empty or is the fallback

**Instrumentation added:**
- Logs track HTML image vs sessionStorage image
- Logs show when restoration is skipped vs when it proceeds
- Logs track the initialization sequence

<reproduction_steps>
1. Clear browser cache and sessionStorage (or use incognito/private mode)
2. Visit `/references` or `/introduction` first (to populate sessionStorage with `home-theme-desktop.webp`)
3. Navigate to `/section-3`, `/section-5`, or `/section-6`
4. Observe if the flash still occurs
5. Check the browser console/network tab to see which image is being loaded
6. If flash persists, check the debug logs at `.cursor/debug.log` to see what's happening
</reproduction_steps>

        },
        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/animations/MPAPageTransition.js",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; // Match preload link crossorigin\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update overlay image element\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    // #region agent log\n    fetch\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n  showPageTransition(element) {\n    return this.transitionAnimations.showPageTransition(element);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Hides the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.hidePageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the hide animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.hidePageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nsetupListeners() {\nasync (event) =&gt; {\n\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n        \n        if (route &amp;&amp; this.siteConfig) {\n          // 2. Update overlay with transition data\n          await this.updateTransitionOverlay(route);\n          \n          // 3. Store transition data in sessionStorage\n          const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n          if (routeConfig &amp;&amp; routeConfig.transition) {\n            this.storeTransitionData(routeConfig.transition);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 4. Show transition\n        const imageBeforeShow = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n        // #region agent log\n        fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:310',message:'setupListeners - BEFORE showTransition',data:{imageSrc:imageBeforeShow?.src,complete:imageBeforeShow?.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run1',hypothesisId:'C'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n        // #endregion\n        await this.showTransition();\n        const imageAfterShow = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n        // #region agent log\n        fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:311',message:'setupListeners - AFTER showTransition',data:{imageSrc:imageAfterShow?.src,complete:imageAfterShow?.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run1',hypothesisId:'C'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n        // #endregion\n        \n        // 5. Navigate to new page\n        this.sessionStorage.setItem(\"pageTransition\", \"true\");\n        window.location.href = href;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error in page transition:', error);\n        // Fallback: navigate without transition\n        window.location.href = href;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener(\"click\", async (event) =&gt; {\n      const target = event.target;\n      if (!target) return;\n      const link = target.closest(\"a\");\n      if (!link) return;\n\n      const href = link.getAttribute(\"href\");\n      const isBlockedLink =\n        href &amp;&amp;\n        this.blocklistLinks.some((blockedLink) =&gt;\n          href.startsWith(blockedLink),\n        );\n      if (isBlockedLink) {\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // prevent same page navigation\n      if (this.isSamePage(href)) {\n        event.preventDefault();\n        this.closeMenuIfOpen();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // animate transition to new page\n      if (!href) return;\n      event.preventDefault();\n\n      // Ensure overlay element is available\n      if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n        this.elements.transitionOverlay = document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\");\n        if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n          console.warn('Transition overlay not found, navigating without transition');\n          window.location.href = href;\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found.         "contents": "export class AnimationsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Create a single IntersectionObserver for all page animations\n   * @param {Array} animations - Array of animation instances\n   */\n  createSharedIntersectionObserver(animations) {\n    // Disconnect previous observer if exists\n    if (this.intersectionObserver) {\n      this.intersectionObserver.disconnect();\n    }\n\n    // Track which elements have already been animated\n    const animatedElements = new Set();\n\n    // Create observer with callback that routes to appropriate animation\n    this.intersectionObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) =&gt; {\n      entries.forEach((entry) =&gt; {\n        // Skip if already animated\n        if (animatedElements.has(entry.target)) {\n          return;\n        }\n\n        // Find the animation instance for this element\n        const animation = animations.find(anim =&gt; anim.element === entry.target);\n        \n        if (!animation) {\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n          animation.animateIn();\n          animatedElements.add(entry.target);\n          this.intersectionObserver.unobserve(entry.target);\n        } else {\n          animation.animateOut();\n        }\n      });\n    }, {\n      rootMargin: '0px',\n      threshold: 0.1\n    });\n\n    // Observe all animated elements\n    animations.forEach((animation) =&gt; {\n      if (animation.element &amp;&amp; animation.element instanceof HTMLElement) {\n        this.intersectionObserver.observe(animation.element);\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register a custom animation (for page-specific animations)\n   * @param {*} animation - GSAP timeline or animation object with kill() method\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  setupTransitionTemplates() {\n    let transitionTemplates = document.createDocumentFragment();\n\n    for (const [route, data] of Object.entries(this.siteConfig.settings)) {\n      let template = this.createTransitionTemplate(route, data);\n      transitionTemplates.appendChild(\n        new DOMParser()\n          .parseFromString(template, \"text/html\")\n          .querySelector(SELECTORS.TEMPLATE)\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Replace all children with the templates from the fragment\n    // Using spread operator to extract all children from the DocumentFragment\n    // This explicitly moves all template elements into the DOM\n    this.transitionTemplates.replaceChildren(...transitionTemplates.children);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Creates a transition template HTML string for a given route\n   * @param {string} route - The route identifier (e.g., \"home\", \"section-1\")\n   * @param {Object} data - Route configuration data from siteConfig\n   * @param {Object} data.transition - Transition configuration\n   * @param {string} data.transition.copy - Text to display during transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.image - Image URL for the transition\n   * @param {string} data.transition.alt - Alt text for the transition image\n   * @returns {string} HTML template string with transition markup\n   * \n   * Removed:\n   * &lt;p class=\"page-transition-overlay__copy\"&gt;${data.transition.copy}&lt;/p&gt;\n   */\n}",

The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n  createSplitTextAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement) {\n    this.splitTexts = [];\n    \n    for (const [index, h1] of elementsArray.entries()) {\n      // Use SplitText mask option to handle clipping automatically\n      const split = SplitText.create(h1, { \n        type: \"chars\",\n        mask: \"chars\" // Automatically handles clipping for background-clip: text effects\n      });\n      this.splitTexts.push(split);\n      \n      // Set initial state: below and invisible\n      gsap.set(split.chars, {\n        y: 100,\n        opacity: 0,\n      });\n      \n      // Animate up with stagger, with delay between each h1\n      this.timeline.to(split.chars, {\n        y: 0,\n        opacity: 1,\n        duration: 0.8,\n        stagger: 0.05,\n        ease: \"power2.out\",\n      }, index * 0.3);\n    }\n    \n    // Calculate fade out timing\n    const lastH1Index = elementsArray.length - 1;\n    const lastAnimationEndTime = lastH1Index * 0.3 + 0.8;\n    const fadeOutStartTime = lastAnimationEndTime + 1;\n    \n    // Fade out each h1's characters\n    for (const [index, split] of this.splitTexts.entries()) {\n      this.timeline.to(split.chars, {\n        y: \"-100%\",\n        opacity: 0,\n        duration: 0.75,\n        stagger: 0.05,\n        ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n      }, fadeOutStartTime + index * 0.05);\n    }\n    \n    // Fade out the preloader element\n    this.timeline.to(preloaderElement, {\n      opacity: 0,\n      duration: 0.5,\n      ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n    }, fadeOutStartTime + \"-=0.3\");\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create fallback animation without SplitText\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray -         "contents": "export class PreloaderAnimation {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Create and run the preloader animation\n   * @param {Object} options - Animation configuration\n   * @param {HTMLElement} options.preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @param {NodeList|Array} options.copyElements - The copy/text elements to animate\n   * @param {Function} options.onComplete - Callback when animation completes\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n  async create({ preloaderElement, copyElements, onComplete }) {\n    // Wait for fonts to load to prevent FOUT (Flash of Unstyled Text)\n    await document.fonts.ready;\n\n    // Reset any existing animation first\n    if (this.timeline) {\n      this.remove();\n    }\n\n    // Validate elements exist\n    if (!preloaderElement) {\n      console.warn('PreloaderAnimation: preloaderElement is required');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const elementsArray = normalizeToArray(copyElements);\n    if (elementsArray.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('PreloaderAnimation: No copy elements found');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.timeline = gsap.timeline({\n      onComplete: () =&gt; {\n        if (onComplete) {\n          onComplete();\n        }\n      },\n    });\n\n    const hasSplitText = typeof SplitText !== 'undefined';\n    \n    if (hasSplitText &amp;&amp; elementsArray.length &gt; 0) {\n      this.createSplitTextAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement);\n    } else {\n      this.createFallbackAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create animation using SplitText with mask option\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray - Array of text elements to animate\n   * @param {HTMLElement} preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n}",

## Summary of Changes

**Root cause:** The overlay became visible before `restoreTransitionData()` ran, so if the image src changed (even briefly), a flash occurred.

**Fixes applied:**

1. Prevented overwriting valid HTML images: `restoreTransitionData()` checks if the HTML already has a valid, non-fallback image and skips restoration if it doesn't match sessionStorage.

2. Reordered initialization sequence:
   - `restoreTransitionData()` runs before the overlay becomes visible
   - After restoration, ensure the image is loaded and painted
   - Only then make the overlay visible

**New sequence:**
1. Early cache check (ensures HTML image is ready)
2. `restoreTransitionData()` (won't overwrite valid HTML images)
3. Verify image is loaded and painted after restoration
4. Make overlay visible (image is correct and painted)

This ensures the correct image is set and painted before the overlay becomes visible, preventing flashes.

<reproduction_steps>
1. Clear browser cache and sessionStorage (or use incognito/private mode)
2. Visit any page (e.g., `/section-3`, `/section-5`, or `/section-6`)
3. Navigate to another page (e.g., from `/section-3` to `/section-5`)
4. Observe if the flash still occurs
5. Check the debug logs at `.cursor/debug.log` to see the sequence of events
6. Try navigating between pages that use different transition images (e.g., `/references` → `/section-3`)
</reproduction_steps>

        "contents": "export class Home extends Page {\nsetupImagePreviewFollower() {\n(wrap) =&gt; {\n\n\n      // Enter/leave per item within this wrap\n      items.forEach((item, index) =&gt; {\n        item.addEventListener(\"mouseenter\", () =&gt; {\n          const forward = prevIndex === null || index &gt; prevIndex;\n          prevIndex = index;\n\n          // animate out existing visuals\n          follower.querySelectorAll(\"[data-follower-visual]\").forEach((el) =&gt; {\n            gsap.killTweensOf(el);\n            gsap.to(el, {\n              yPercent: forward ? -offset : offset,\n              duration,\n              ease,\n              overwrite: \"auto\",\n              onComplete: () =&gt; el.remove(),\n            });\n          });\n\n          // clone &amp; insert new visual\n          const visual = item.querySelector(\"[data-follower-visual]\");\n          if (!visual) return;\n          const clone = visual.cloneNode(true);\n          followerInner.appendChild(clone);\n\n          // animate it in (unless it's the very first entry)\n          if (!firstEntry) {\n            gsap.fromTo(\n              clone,\n              { yPercent: forward ? offset : -offset },\n              { yPercent: 0, duration, ease, overwrite: \"auto\" }\n            );\n          } else {\n            firstEntry = false;\n          }\n        });\n\n        item.addEventListener(\"mouseleave\", () =&gt; {\n          const el = follower.querySelector(\"[data-follower-visual]\");\n          if (!el) return;\n          gsap.killTweensOf(el);\n          gsap.to(el, {\n            yPercent: -offset,\n            duration,\n            ease,\n            overwrite: \"auto\",\n            onComplete: () =&gt; el.remove(),\n          });\n        });\n      });\n\n      // If pointer leaves the collection, clear any visuals\n      collection.addEventListener(\"mouseleave\", () =&gt; {\n        follower.querySelectorAll(\"[data-follower-visual]\").forEach((el) =&gt; {\n          gsap.killTweensOf(el);\n          gsap.delayedCall(duration, () =&gt; el.remove());\n        });\n        firstEntry = true;\n        prevIndex = null;\n      });\n    });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class Home extends Page {\n\n\n  setupImagePreviewFollower() {\n    const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-follower-wrap]\");\n\n    wrappers.forEach((wrap) =&gt; {\n      const collection = wrap.querySelector(\"[data-follower-collection]\");\n      const items = wrap.querySelectorAll(\"[data-follower-item]\");\n      const follower = wrap.querySelector(\"[data-follower-cursor]\");\n      const followerInner = wrap.querySelector(\"[data-follower-cursor-inner]\");\n\n      let prevIndex = null;\n      let firstEntry = true;\n\n      const offset = 100; // The animation distance in %\n      const duration = 0.5; // The animation duration of all visual transforms\n      const ease = \"power2.inOut\";\n\n      // Initialize follower position\n      gsap.set(follower, { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50 });\n\n      // Quick setters for x/y\n      const xTo = gsap.quickTo(follower, \"x\", {\n        duration: 0.6,\n        ease: \"power3\",\n      });\n      const yTo = gsap.quickTo(follower, \"y\", {\n        duration: 0.6,\n        ease: \"power3\",\n      });\n\n      // Move all followers on mousemove\n      window.addEventListener(\"mousemove\", (e) =&gt; {\n        xTo(e.clientX);\n        yTo(e.clientY);\n      });\n\n      // Enter/leave per item within this wrap\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { Footnotes } from \"../components/Footnotes.js\";\nimport { SmoothScroll } from \"../components/SmoothScroll.js\";\nimport { Navigation } from \"../components/Navigation.js\";\nimport { AnimationsManager } from \"../animations/AnimationsManager.js\";\n\n/**\n * Simplified service factory for Multi-Page Application (MPA)\n * Creates only the services needed for page initialization, without SPA routing services\n */\nexport function createMPAServices() {\n  const siteConfig = new SiteConfig();\n  const smoothScroll = new SmoothScroll();\n  const animationsManager = new AnimationsManager();\n  const footnotes = new Footnotes({ smoothScroll });\n  \n  // Navigation in MPA doesn't need pageRegistry (no dynamic page tracking)\n  // We'll pass null for pageRegistry and update Navigation to handle it\n  const navigation = new Navigation({ \n    siteConfig, \n    pageRegistry: null, \n    smoothScroll \n  });\n\n  return {\n    siteConfig,\n    smoothScroll,\n    animationsManager,\n    footnotes,\n    navigation,\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nsetupListeners() {\nasync (event) =&gt; {\n\n          window.location.href = href;\n          return;\n        }\n      }\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n        \n        if (route &amp;&amp; this.siteConfig) {\n          // 2. Update overlay with transition data\n          await this.updateTransitionOverlay(route);\n          \n          // 3. Store transition data in sessionStorage\n          const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n          if (routeConfig &amp;&amp; routeConfig.transition) {\n            this.storeTransitionData(routeConfig.transition);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 4. Show transition\n        const imageBeforeShow = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n        // #region agent log\n        fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:310',message:'setupListeners - BEFORE showTransition',data:{imageSrc:imageBeforeShow?.src,complete:imageBeforeShow?.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run1',hypothesisId:'C'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n        // #endregion\n        await this.showTransition();\n        const imageAfterShow = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n        // #region agent log\n        fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:311',message:'setupListeners - AFTER showTransition',data:{imageSrc:imageAfterShow?.src,complete:imageAfterShow?.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run1',hypothesisId:'C'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n        // #endregion\n        \n        // 5. Navigate to new page\n        this.sessionStorage.setItem(\"pageTransition\", \"true\");\n        window.location.href = href;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nconstructor({ siteConfig }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n  async init() {\n    // Helper function to perform initialization\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      whenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n        this.pageTransition = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_OVERLAY);\n        this.transitionTemplates = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_TEMPLATES);\n\n        this.setupTransitionTemplates();\n        this.initializePreloading();\n        resolve();\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nsetupListeners() {\nasync (event) =&gt; {\n\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  async showTransition() {\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n        resolve();\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Set initial state: hidden (scaleY: 0, opacity: 0)\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n        opacity: 0,\n      });\n      \n      // Animate to visible (scaleY: 1, opacity: 1)\n      this.gsap.to(this.elements.transitionOverlay, {\n        opacity: 1,\n        duration: 0.6,\n        ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        onComplete: resolve,\n      });\n    });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { ImageService } from \"../utilities/ImageService.js\";\nimport { whenDOMReady } from \"../utilities/AsyncHelpers.js\";\nimport { $ } from \"../utilities/DOMHelpers.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\n\n/**\n * TransitionsManager class for managing the transition overlay\n * Handles the transition overlay templates and preloading of images\n * Manages the transition overlay elements\n */\nexport class TransitionsManager {\n  /**\n   * Creates a new TransitionsManager instance\n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {import(\"../config/SiteConfig.js\").SiteConfig} options.siteConfig - Site configuration containing route and transition data\n   */\n  constructor({ siteConfig }) {\n    this.siteConfig = siteConfig;\n    this.imageLoader = new ImageService();\n    this.pageTransition = null;\n    this.transitionTemplates = null;\n    this.transitionAnimations = new PageTransition();\n    // * Note: Don't call init() here - let App call it when DOM is ready\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; // Match preload link crossorigin\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Update overlay image element\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    // #region agent log\n    fetch\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Link transitions that animate between pages\n */\nexport class PageTransition {\n  constructor() {\n    this.timelines = [];\n  }\n\n  async showPageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const transitionTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      transitionTimeline\n        .to(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          duration: 1.25,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        })\n        .set(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          delay: .5,\n        });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async hidePageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const hideTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      // ✅ CRITICAL: Animate the main element FIRST at position 0\n      // This ensures it always animates even if child elements don't exist\n      hideTimeline.to(\n        element,\n        {\n          opacity: 0,\n          duration: 1,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        },\n        0\n      ); // Position 0 = start immediately\n    });\n  }\n}",

## Summary of Fixes

**Root cause:** The overlay started at `opacity: 0` in CSS, so page content could flash before GSAP set it visible. Also, `hideTransition()` wasn't awaited, so page content could appear before the overlay finished hiding.

**Fixes applied:**

1. Immediate overlay visibility: Check `isPageNavigating` at the start of `initialize()` and set the overlay visible synchronously (before any async work) to cover page content immediately.

2. Await hideTransition: Added `await` before `hideTransition()` so the overlay finishes hiding before page content becomes visible.

3. Prevented overwriting valid HTML images: `restoreTransitionData()` skips restoration if the HTML already has a valid, non-fallback image.

**New sequence:**
1. Check `isPageNavigating` immediately → set overlay visible synchronously (covers page content)
2. Early cache check (ensures HTML image is ready)
3. `restoreTransitionData()` (won't overwrite valid HTML images)
4. Verify image is loaded and painted after restoration
5. Ensure overlay is still visible
6. Await `hideTransition()` (overlay hides completely before page content shows)

This ensures:
- Overlay covers page content from the start (no text flash)
- Correct image is set and painted before overlay becomes visible
- Overlay stays visible until hide animation completes

<reproduction_steps>
1. Clear browser cache and sessionStorage (or use incognito/private mode)
2. Visit any page (e.g., `/section-3`, `/section-5`, or `/section-6`)
3. Navigate to another page
4. Observe if the text flash still occurs
5. Check the debug logs at `.cursor/debug.log` to verify the sequence
6. Try navigating between pages that use different transition images
</reproduction_steps>

## Summary of Fix

**Root cause:** The overlay was made visible before the image was ready. For newly visited pages, the image might not be loaded, causing a blue/white background flash.

**Fix applied:**

Reordered initialization so:
1. `restoreTransitionData()` runs first (may change image src from HTML to sessionStorage)
2. Wait for the final image to load and paint
3. Then make the overlay visible
4. Await `hideTransition()` to complete

This ensures:
- The correct image (from `restoreTransitionData`) is loaded and painted before the overlay becomes visible
- No intermediate state where the overlay is visible but the image isn't ready
- The overlay covers page content immediately with the correct image

**New sequence for navigating pages:**
1. Check `isPageNavigating`
2. Call `restoreTransitionData()` (may change image src)
3. Wait for final image to load (`waitForImageLoad`)
4. Force paint (`offsetHeight` + `requestAnimationFrame`)
5. Set overlay visible (image is ready and painted)
6. Await `hideTransition()` (overlay hides completely)

<reproduction_steps>
1. Clear browser cache and sessionStorage (or use incognito/private mode)
2. Visit a newly visited page (e.g., `/section-3`, `/section-5`, or `/section-6`)
3. Observe if the blue background flash still occurs
4. Navigate to another page and check again
5. Check the debug logs at `.cursor/debug.log` to verify the sequence:
   - `restoreTransitionData` completes
   - Image loads and paints
   - Overlay becomes visible AFTER image is ready
</reproduction_steps>

        "contents": "/**\n * Link transitions that animate between pages\n */\nexport class PageTransition {\n  constructor() {\n    this.timelines = [];\n  }\n\n  async showPageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const transitionTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      transitionTimeline\n        .to(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          duration: 1.25,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        })\n        .set(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          delay: .5,\n        });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async hidePageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const hideTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      // ✅ CRITICAL: Animate the main element FIRST at position 0\n      // This ensures it always animates even if child elements don't exist\n      hideTimeline.to(\n        element,\n        {\n          opacity: 0,\n          duration: 1,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        },\n        0\n      ); // Position 0 = start immediately\n    });\n  }\n}",

{\n        src: imageAfterRestore.src,\n        complete: imageAfterRestore.complete\n;\n  }\n}",

{\n        src: imageElement.src,\n        complete: imageElement.complete,\n        naturalHeight: imageElement.naturalHeight\n      } : null;\n      // #region agent log\n      fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:300',message:'initialize - BEFORE restoreTransitionData',data:{overlayOpacity:overlayBeforeRestore.opacity,imageBeforeRestore},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run6',hypothesisId:'L'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n      // #endregion\n      \n      // Step 1: Restore transition data (may change image src from HTML to sessionStorage value)\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      // Step 2: Get the final image element (may have changed after restore)\n      const imageAfterRestore = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      // #region agent log\n      fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:308',message:'initialize - AFTER restoreTransitionData',data:{imageSrc:imageAfterRestore?.src,complete:imageAfterRestore?.complete,naturalHeight:imageAfterRestore?.naturalHeight},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run6',hypothesisId:'L'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n      // #endregion\n      \n      // Step 3: Ensure image is fully loaded and painted BEFORE making overlay visible\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nshowPageTransition(element) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Hides the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.hidePageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the hide animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.hidePageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n  hidePageTransition(element) {\n    return this.transitionAnimations.hidePageTransition(element);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Normalizes a route string by removing leading slash\n   * Ensures consistent route format for template lookups\n   * @param {string} route - Route string that may or may not start with \"/\"\n   * @returns {string} Normalized route without leading slash\n   * @example\n   * normalizeRoute(\"/home\") // Returns \"home\"\n   * normalizeRoute(\"section-1\") // Returns \"section-1\"\n   */\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync initialize() {\n\n      // #endregion\n      \n      // Step 3: Ensure image is fully loaded and painted BEFORE making overlay visible\n      if (imageAfterRestore &amp;&amp; imageAfterRestore.src) {\n        // Ensure crossorigin matches preload link to use cached resource\n        imageAfterRestore.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        // Wait for image to be fully loaded AND painted before making overlay visible\n        // Even if complete=true, the image might not be painted yet for unvisited pages\n        if (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n          // #region agent log\n          fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:317',message:'initialize - WAITING for image load after restore',data:{src:imageAfterRestore.src,complete:imageAfterRestore.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run6',hypothesisId:'L'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n          // #endregion\n          await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n          // #region agent log\n          fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:320',message:'initialize - image LOADED after restore',data:{src:imageAfterRestore.src,complete:imageAfterRestore.complete,naturalHeight:imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run6',hypothesisId:'L'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n          // #endregion\n        }\n        \n        // CRITICAL FIX: Force browser to paint the image BEFORE overlay becomes visible\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nsetupListeners() {\nasync (event) =&gt; {\n\n\n      try {\n        // 1. Normalize href to route key\n        const route = this.normalizeHrefToRoute(href);\n        \n        if (route &amp;&amp; this.siteConfig) {\n          // 2. Update overlay with transition data\n          await this.updateTransitionOverlay(route);\n          \n          // 3. Store transition data in sessionStorage\n          const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n          if (routeConfig &amp;&amp; routeConfig.transition) {\n            this.storeTransitionData(routeConfig.transition);\n          }\n        }\n\n        // 4. Show transition\n        const imageBeforeShow = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n        // #region agent log\n        fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:310',message:'setupListeners - BEFORE showTransition',data:{imageSrc:imageBeforeShow?.src,complete:imageBeforeShow?.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run1',hypothesisId:'C'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n        // #endregion\n        await this.showTransition();\n        const imageAfterShow = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n        // #region agent log\n        fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:311',message:'setupListeners - AFTER showTransition',data:{imageSrc:imageAfterShow?.src,complete:imageAfterShow?.complete},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run1',hypothesisId:'C'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n        // #endregion\n        \n        // 5. Navigate to new page\n        this.sessionStorage.setItem(\"pageTransition\", \"true\");\n        window.location.href = href;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Error in page transition:', error);\n        // Fallback: navigate without transition\n        window.location.href = href;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found. Transition animations may not work.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Check if navigating - we need to restore data and ensure image is ready BEFORE overlay becomes visible\n    // This prevents blue/white background flash on newly visited pages\n    this.isPageNavigating = this.sessionStorage.getItem(\"pageTransition\") === \"true\";\n    \n    // Get image element first\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    // #region agent log\n    fetch('http://127.0.0.1:7243/ingest/e9a9d209-264a-4820-9a2e-668eb28054fe',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({location:'MPAPageTransition.js:287',message:'initialize ENTRY',data:{hasImageElement:!!imageElement,initialSrc:imageElement?.src,complete:imageElement?.complete,naturalHeight:imageElement?.naturalHeight,isPageNavigating:this.isPageNavigating,currentPath:window.location.pathname},timestamp:Date.now(),sessionId:'debug-session',runId:'run6',hypothesisId:'L'})}).catch(()=&gt;{});\n    // #endregion\n    \n    // Set up listeners after elements are found\n    this.setupListeners();\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: If navigating, restore transition data FIRST, then ensure image is ready, THEN make overlay visible\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n *  Entry point for the application\n *  Handles shared initialization for MPA: preloader, navigation, page transitions\n */\n\nimport { createMPAServices } from \"./services/MPAServiceFactory.js\";\nimport { Preloader } from \"./components/Preloader.js\";\nimport { MPAPageTransition } from \"./animations/MPAPageTransition.js\";\nimport { TransitionsManager } from \"./animations/TransitionsManager.js\";\nimport { liveReload } from \"./config/Environment.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, EVENTS } from \"./utilities/Constants.js\";\nimport { $ } from \"./utilities/DOMHelpers.js\";\nimport { whenDOMReady } from \"./utilities/AsyncHelpers.js\";\n\nclass App {\n  constructor() {\n    this.preloaderVisible = false;\n    this.initialized = false;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize the application state\n   * Made idempotent - safe to run multiple times\n   */\n}",

Documenting the timeline and the issue:

What I'm fixing:
- Blue background flash when navigating to newly visited pages (e.g., `/section-5`). The overlay hides, but page content becomes visible before the overlay fully disappears, causing a brief blue flash.

Timeline from logs (for `/section-5` visit):
1. Line 141: `initialize ENTRY` — Page loads, overlay opacity: "0", image ready
2. Line 142: `BEFORE restoreTransitionData` — Overlay still opacity: "0"
3. Lines 143-149: `restoreTransitionData` — Image already correct, skipped
4. Line 150: `AFTER restoreTransitionData` — Image ready
5. Lines 151-152: Force paint — Image painted
6. Line 153: `overlay visible AFTER image ready` — Overlay opacity set to "1"
7. Line 154: `BEFORE hideTransition` — Starting hide animation
8. Lines 155-160: `hideTransition` runs — Overlay animates to opacity: 0 (duration: 0.6s, delay: 0.5s = 1.1s total)
9. Line 161: `AFTER hideTransition` — Animation complete

The problem:
- The overlay animates to `opacity: 0` but doesn't set `scaleY: 0` or `visibility: hidden`.
- When opacity reaches 0, the overlay is transparent but still present, so page content shows through.
- If the page has a blue background, it flashes through the transparent overlay.

The fix:
- Ensure the overlay fully covers the page content until it's completely hidden. Either:
  1. Set `scaleY: 0` when hiding (so it doesn't cover), or
  2. Keep the overlay covering until the animation completes, then remove it.

Checking the current hide animation:

## Summary

**What I'm fixing:**
Blue background flash when navigating to newly visited pages (e.g., `/section-5`). The overlay hides but doesn't fully collapse, so page content shows through the transparent overlay.

**Timeline of the error:**

1. Page loads → `initialize()` runs
2. Overlay set visible (`opacity: 1`, `scaleY: 1`) with image ready
3. `hideTransition()` starts → overlay animates to `opacity: 0` only
4. Bug: overlay becomes transparent but still covers the page (`scaleY` stays at `1`)
5. Page content (blue background) shows through the transparent overlay → blue flash
6. Animation completes → overlay still present but invisible

**Root cause:**
The `hideTransition` animation only animates `opacity: 0`, not `scaleY: 0`. The comment says "Animate to hidden (scaleY: 0, opacity: 0)" but the code only animates opacity.

**Fix applied:**
Updated `hideTransition` to animate both `opacity: 0` and `scaleY: 0`, so the overlay fully collapses and doesn't cover the page when transparent.

**New sequence:**
1. Overlay visible with image (`opacity: 1`, `scaleY: 1`)
2. `hideTransition()` animates both `opacity: 0` and `scaleY: 0`
3. Overlay collapses and fades out simultaneously
4. No blue background flash

<reproduction_steps>
1. Clear browser cache and sessionStorage (or use incognito/private mode)
2. Visit `/section-5` (or another newly visited page)
3. Observe if the blue background flash still occurs after the page loads
4. Check the debug logs at `.cursor/debug.log` to verify:
   - Overlay `scaleY` animates from `1` to `0`
   - Overlay `opacity` animates from `1` to `0`
   - Both complete together
</reproduction_steps>

        "contents": "    &lt;script type=\"module\"&gt;\n  import { View } from '../app/pages/View.js';\n  import { whenDOMReady } from '../app/utilities/AsyncHelpers.js';\n  import { $ } from '../app/utilities/DOMHelpers.js';\n  import { ATTRIBUTES } from '../app/utilities/Constants.js';\n  \n  whenDOMReady(async () =&gt; {\n    // Read the template from the main element to determine the element selector\n    const main = $(\"main[data-template]\");\n    const template = main?.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTES.DATA_TEMPLATE);\n    \n    if (!template) {\n      console.error(\"No data-template attribute found on main element\");\n      return;\n    }\n    \n    // Create element selector from template (e.g., \"section-1\" -&gt; \".section-1\")\n    const elementSelector = '.' + template;\n    \n    // Get services from App.js (or create if App.js hasn't loaded yet)\n    let services = window.appServices;\n    if (!services) {\n      const { createMPAServices } = await import('../app/services/MPAServiceFactory.js');\n      services = createMPAServices();\n    }\n    \n    // Initialize page with the template-based element selector\n    const page = new View({\n      element: elementSelector,\n      ...services,\n    });\n    await page.create();\n    await page.show();\n  });\n&lt;/script&gt;\n  &lt;/body&gt;\n&lt;/html&gt;",

## What I'm fixing

Blue flash when navigating to a new page. The overlay starts at `opacity: 0` (CSS default), so page content shows before JavaScript sets it visible.

## Timeline from logs

1. Line 142: New page loads → overlay opacity: "0" (CSS default)
2. Lines 143-152: Async work (restoreTransitionData, image wait, paint) — ~13ms
3. Line 153: Overlay becomes visible → opacity: "1"

The gap between page render and overlay visibility causes the blue flash.

## About `scaleY`

`scaleY` is a CSS transform that scales vertically:
- `scaleY: 1` = full height
- `scaleY: 0` = collapsed to zero height

It’s used for the vertical slide animation. Removing it wouldn’t fix the flash; the issue is the overlay not being visible on initial page load.

## Fix applied

Set the overlay visible immediately (synchronously) at the start of `initialize()`, before any async work. This covers the page content right away, preventing the blue flash. The HTML already includes the image `src` (from the build), so it should display immediately.

**New sequence:**
1. Page loads → overlay opacity: "0" (CSS)
2. JavaScript starts → overlay set visible immediately (synchronously) → opacity: "1"
3. Async work happens (restoreTransitionData, image wait, paint) — overlay already visible
4. Image ready → overlay still visible with correct image
5. Hide animation → overlay fades out

<reproduction_steps>
1. Clear browser cache and sessionStorage (or use incognito/private mode)
2. Visit `/section-5` (or another newly visited page)
3. Observe if the blue background flash still occurs after the page loads
4. Check the debug logs at `.cursor/debug.log` to verify:
   - Overlay becomes visible IMMEDIATELY (synchronously) at the start of initialize
   - No gap between page render and overlay visibility
   - Image is ready and painted after overlay is already visible
</reproduction_steps>

`showTransition()` is fine—it sets opacity to 0 first, then fades in. Summary of changes:

## Summary of Changes

**1. CSS Default (`_page-transitions.scss`):**
- Changed overlay default from `opacity: 0` to `opacity: 1`
- Overlay is visible immediately when HTML loads, covering page content

**2. JavaScript (`MPAPageTransition.js`):**
- Removed code that sets overlay visible (it's already visible by default)
- Updated comments to reflect that overlay is visible by default
- When navigating: overlay is already visible, so we just ensure the image is ready and fade out
- When NOT navigating: explicitly hide overlay (`opacity: 0`) since it's visible by default

**New Flow:**
1. Page HTML loads → Overlay visible by default (`opacity: 1` in CSS) → Covers page content immediately
2. JavaScript runs → Ensures correct image is ready
3. Fade out overlay → Smooth transition to reveal page content

This removes the race condition: the overlay covers content from the start, so no blue flash occurs before JavaScript runs. The overlay fades out once the image is ready and the page is prepared.
