        "contents": "export class Preloader extends Component {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Remove the preloader element and clean up event listeners\n   */\n  destroy() {\n    // Clean up animation before destroying the preloader\n    if (this.preloaderAnimation) {\n      this.preloaderAnimation.remove();\n    }\n\n    // Remove DOM element\n    if (this.element) {\n      this.element.remove();\n    }\n    \n    // Remove all event listeners (prevents memory leaks)\n    // This removes any listeners registered via this.on() or this.once()\n    this.removeAllListeners(EVENTS.PRELOADER_COMPLETE);\n\n    // Clear references\n    this.element = null;\n    this.elements = null;\n    this.images = null;\n    this.preloaderAnimation = null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class Navigation extends Component {\naddEventListeners() {\n\n  }\n\n\n  setupTitleObserver() {\n    if (!this.title) return;\n\n    // Scroll threshold in pixels - fade out after scrolling this amount\n    const scrollThreshold = VALUES.NAV_SCROLL_THRESHOLD;\n    \n    // Track current fade state to avoid unnecessary animations\n    this.titleIsFadedOut = false;\n    this.titleFadeTimeline = null;\n\n    const handleScroll = () =&gt; {\n      const scrollY = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;\n\n      if (scrollY &gt; scrollThreshold &amp;&amp; !this.titleIsFadedOut) {\n        // Fade out title\n        this.titleIsFadedOut = true;\n        \n        if (this.titleFadeTimeline) {\n          this.titleFadeTimeline.kill();\n        }\n\n        this.titleFadeTimeline = gsap.to(this.title, {\n          opacity: 0,\n          duration: 0.5,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        });\n      } else if (scrollY &lt;= scrollThreshold &amp;&amp; this.titleIsFadedOut) {\n        // Fade in title\n        this.titleIsFadedOut = false;\n        \n        if (this.titleFadeTimeline) {\n          this.titleFadeTimeline.kill();\n        }\n\n        this.titleFadeTimeline = gsap.to(this.title, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          duration: 0.5,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        });\n      }\n    };\n\n    // Store reference for cleanup\n    this.titleScrollHandler = handleScroll;\n\n    // Add scroll listener with passive flag for better performance\n    this.addListenerAndRegister(window, \"scroll\", this.titleScrollHandler, { passive: true });\n\n    // Initial check in case page is already scrolled\n    handleScroll();\n  }\n\n  setupMenuButtonStyles() {\n    if (!this.menuButton) return;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class Navigation extends Component {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Listen for esc key press to close navigation\n   *\n   */\n  addEventListeners() {\n    if (!this.navigation) return;\n    \n    // Escape key handler\n    this.escapeKeyHandler = (e) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === \"Escape\" || e.code === \"Escape\") {\n        if (\n          this.navigation.getAttribute(\"data-navigation-status\") === \"active\"\n        ) {\n          this.navigation.setAttribute(\"data-navigation-status\", \"not-active\");\n        }\n      }\n    };\n    this.addListenerAndRegister(document, \"keydown\", this.escapeKeyHandler);\n\n    // M key handler\n    this.mKeyHandler = (e) =&gt; {\n      if (e.key === \"M\" || e.code === \"KeyM\") {\n        if (this.menuButton) {\n          this.menuButton.click();\n        }\n      }\n    };\n    this.addListenerAndRegister(document, \"keydown\", this.mKeyHandler);\n  }\n\n\n  setupTitleObserver() {\n    if (!this.title) return;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class Navigation extends Component {\ngetNavigationStatus() {\n\n  }\n\n  setupLinkListeners() {\n    // In MPA, browser handles navigation. Close menu when links are clicked.\n    this.menuLinkHandlers = [];\n    for (const link of this.menuLinks) {\n      const handler = (event) =&gt; {\n        const isMenuActive =\n          this.navigation.getAttribute(\"data-navigation-status\") === \"active\";\n        if (isMenuActive) {\n          setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n            this.hideNavigation();\n          }, VALUES.NAV_TIMEOUT);\n        }\n      };\n      this.menuLinkHandlers.push({ link, handler });\n      this.addListenerAndRegister(link, \"click\", handler);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Listen for esc key press to close navigation\n   *\n   */\n  addEventListeners() {\n    if (!this.navigation) return;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize preloading strategy for transition images\n   * Uses requestIdleCallback when available, otherwise falls back to setTimeout\n   * Preloading happens during browser idle time to avoid blocking main thread\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  initializePreloading() {\n    // Preload during idle time\n    if (\"requestIdleCallback\" in window) {\n      requestIdleCallback(() =&gt; {\n        this.preloadAllTransitionImages();\n      });\n    } else {\n      // Fallback for browsers without requestIdleCallback\n      setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        this.preloadAllTransitionImages();\n      }, 2000);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Extract all image elements from transition templates\n   * @returns {HTMLImageElement[]} Array of image elements with data-src attributes\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class PreloaderAnimation {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Create and run the preloader animation\n   * @param {Object} options - Animation configuration\n   * @param {HTMLElement} options.preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @param {NodeList|Array} options.copyElements - The copy/text elements to animate\n   * @param {Function} options.onComplete - Callback when animation completes\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n  async create({ preloaderElement, copyElements, onComplete }) {\n    // Wait for fonts to load to prevent FOUT (Flash of Unstyled Text)\n    await document.fonts.ready;\n\n    // Reset any existing animation first\n    if (this.timeline) {\n      this.remove();\n    }\n\n    // Validate elements exist\n    if (!preloaderElement) {\n      console.warn('PreloaderAnimation: preloaderElement is required');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const elementsArray = normalizeToArray(copyElements);\n    if (elementsArray.length === 0) {\n      console.warn('PreloaderAnimation: No copy elements found');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.timeline = gsap.timeline({\n      onComplete: () =&gt; {\n        if (onComplete) {\n          onComplete();\n        }\n      },\n    });\n\n    const hasSplitText = typeof SplitText !== 'undefined';\n    \n    if (hasSplitText &amp;&amp; elementsArray.length &gt; 0) {\n      this.createSplitTextAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement);\n    } else {\n      this.createFallbackAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create animation using SplitText with mask option\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray - Array of text elements to animate\n   * @param {HTMLElement} preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Preload all transition images during idle time using ImageService\n   * Images are decoded for layout-ready rendering\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when all images are preloaded (or failed)\n   */\n  async preloadAllTransitionImages() {\n    const imageElements = this.getAllTransitionImageElements();\n\n    if (imageElements.length === 0) return;\n\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.preloadImages({\n        images: imageElements,\n        container: this.transitionTemplates,\n        useDecode: true, // Use decode for layout-ready images\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(\"Error preloading transition images:\", error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if an image URL has been preloaded\n   * @param {string} url - Image URL to check\n   * @returns {boolean} True if the image URL is in the preloaded set\n   * @example\n   * if (transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n   *   Image is already cached\n   * }\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * Uses ImageService for consistent behavior\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   * @example\n   * const img = document.querySelector('img[data-src]');\n   * await transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(img);\n   */\n  async preloadSingleImage(imgElement) {\n    if (!imgElement || !imgElement.dataset.src) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      return await this.imageLoader.preloadSingleImage(imgElement);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(\n        &#96;Failed to preload transition image: ${imgElement.dataset.src}&#96;,\n        error\n      );\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; // Match preload link crossorigin\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      // Ensure crossorigin matches preload link\n      imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync restoreTransitionData() {\n\n        \n        if (!imageAlreadyCorrect) {\n          const isPreloaded = this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(transitionData.image);\n          \n          if (isPreloaded) {\n            imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n          } else {\n            const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n            tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', transitionData.image);\n            tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n            if (this.transitionsManager) {\n              await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n            } else {\n              await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n            }\n            imageElement.src = transitionData.image;\n          }\n          \n          if (transitionData.alt) {\n            imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error restoring transition data:', error);\n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found. Transition animations may not work.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.isPageNavigating = this.sessionStorage.getItem(\"pageTransition\") === \"true\";\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    \n    this.setupListeners();\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      const imageAfterRestore = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageAfterRestore &amp;&amp; imageAfterRestore.src) {\n        imageAfterRestore.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        if (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n          await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n        }\n        \n        void imageAfterRestore.offsetHeight;\n        await new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n      }\n      \n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      await this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Initial state: overlay hidden\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        opacity: 0\n      });\n      \n      // Ensure crossorigin is set for future use\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; imageElement.src) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nconstructor({ siteConfig }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n  async init() {\n    // Helper function to perform initialization\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      whenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n        this.pageTransition = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_OVERLAY);\n        this.transitionTemplates = $(SELECTORS.TRANSITION_TEMPLATES);\n\n        this.setupTransitionTemplates();\n        this.initializePreloading();\n        resolve();\n      });\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Sets up transition templates from site configuration\n   * Creates template elements for each route and adds them to the DOM\n   * Templates are stored in the #page-transition-overlay-templates container\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class PreloaderAnimation {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Create fallback animation without SplitText\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray - Array of text elements to animate\n   * @param {HTMLElement} preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n  createFallbackAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement) {\n    // Set initial state\n    gsap.set(elementsArray, {\n      y: 100,\n      opacity: 0,\n    });\n    \n    // Animate elements in\n    this.timeline.to(elementsArray, {\n      y: 0,\n      opacity: 1,\n      duration: 0.8,\n      stagger: 0.05,\n      ease: \"power2.out\",\n    });\n\n    // Wait 1 second, then fade out elements\n    this.timeline.to(elementsArray, {\n      y: \"-100%\",\n      opacity: 0,\n      duration: 0.75,\n      stagger: 0.05,\n      ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n    }, \"+=1\"); // Position parameter: wait 1 second after previous animation\n    \n    // Fade out the preloader element (slightly before elements finish)\n    this.timeline.to(preloaderElement, {\n      opacity: 0,\n      duration: 0.5,\n      ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n    }, \"-=0.3\");\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Run the animation (alias for create for consistency with other animation classes)\n   * @param {Object} options - Animation configuration\n   * @param {HTMLElement} options.preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @param {NodeList|Array} options.copyElements - The copy/text elements to animate\n   * @param {Function} options.onComplete - Callback when animation completes\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { ImageService } from \"../utilities/ImageService.js\";\nimport { whenDOMReady } from \"../utilities/AsyncHelpers.js\";\nimport { $ } from \"../utilities/DOMHelpers.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\n\n/**\n * TransitionsManager class for managing the transition overlay\n * Handles the transition overlay templates and preloading of images\n * Manages the transition overlay elements\n */\nexport class TransitionsManager {\n  /**\n   * Creates a new TransitionsManager instance\n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {import(\"../config/SiteConfig.js\").SiteConfig} options.siteConfig - Site configuration containing route and transition data\n   */\n  constructor({ siteConfig }) {\n    this.siteConfig = siteConfig;\n    this.imageLoader = new ImageService();\n    this.pageTransition = null;\n    this.transitionTemplates = null;\n    this.transitionAnimations = new PageTransition();\n    // * Note: Don't call init() here - let App call it when DOM is ready\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize TransitionsManager - call this when DOM is ready\n   * Handles both cases: DOM already loaded (hard refresh) or loading dynamically\n   * Sets up transition templates and initializes image preloading strategy\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when initialization is complete\n   * @example\n   * const transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ siteConfig });\n   * await transitionsManager.init();\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class PreloaderAnimation {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Create animation using SplitText with mask option\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray - Array of text elements to animate\n   * @param {HTMLElement} preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n  createSplitTextAnimation(elementsArray, preloaderElement) {\n    this.splitTexts = [];\n    \n    for (const [index, h1] of elementsArray.entries()) {\n      // Use SplitText mask option to handle clipping automatically\n      const split = SplitText.create(h1, { \n        type: \"chars\",\n        mask: \"chars\" // Automatically handles clipping for background-clip: text effects\n      });\n      this.splitTexts.push(split);\n      \n      // Set initial state: below and invisible\n      gsap.set(split.chars, {\n        y: 100,\n        opacity: 0,\n      });\n      \n      // Animate up with stagger, with delay between each h1\n      this.timeline.to(split.chars, {\n        y: 0,\n        opacity: 1,\n        duration: 0.8,\n        stagger: 0.05,\n        ease: \"power2.out\",\n      }, index * 0.3);\n    }\n    \n    // Calculate fade out timing\n    const lastH1Index = elementsArray.length - 1;\n    const lastAnimationEndTime = lastH1Index * 0.3 + 0.8;\n    const fadeOutStartTime = lastAnimationEndTime + 1;\n    \n    // Fade out each h1's characters\n    for (const [index, split] of this.splitTexts.entries()) {\n      this.timeline.to(split.chars, {\n        y: \"-100%\",\n        opacity: 0,\n        duration: 0.75,\n        stagger: 0.05,\n        ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n      }, fadeOutStartTime + index * 0.05);\n    }\n    \n    // Fade out the preloader element\n    this.timeline.to(preloaderElement, {\n      opacity: 0,\n      duration: 0.5,\n      ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n    }, fadeOutStartTime + \"-=0.3\");\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Create fallback animation without SplitText\n   * @param {Array} elementsArray - Array of text elements to animate\n   * @param {HTMLElement} preloaderElement - The main preloader element\n   * @private\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Check if an image URL has been preloaded\n   * @param {string} url - Image URL to check\n   * @returns {boolean} True if the image URL is in the preloaded set\n   * @example\n   * if (transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n   *   Image is already cached\n   * }\n   */\n  isImagePreloaded(url) {\n    return this.imageLoader.isImagePreloaded(url);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * Uses ImageService for consistent behavior\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   * @example\n   * const img = document.querySelector('img[data-src]');\n   * await transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(img);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\nconst imageElement = ('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      // Ensure crossorigin matches preload link\n      imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n      \n      if (imageReady) {\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      } else {\n        // Set src anyway - browser will load it\n        imageElement.src = imageUrl;\n      }\n      \n      if (transitionData.alt) {\n        imageElement.alt = transitionData.alt;\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (imageElement) {\n      try {\n        await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageElement);\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn('Error waiting for transition image load:', error);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\nasync updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n    const transitionData = transitionTemplate.content.cloneNode(true);\n    const img = transitionData.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n\n    if (!img) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Set src on cloned image (should be instant from cache)\n    img.src = imageUrl;\n\n    // Wait for cloned image to be ready (should be instant if cached, but ensures it's loaded)\n    try {\n      await this.imageLoader.waitForImageLoad(img);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to ensure cloned image is ready for transition: ${imageUrl}&#96;, error);\n      // Continue anyway - image may still display\n    }\n\n    // Guard: Check if pageTransition exists\n    if (this.pageTransition) {\n      this.pageTransition.replaceChildren(transitionData);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Shows the page transition overlay with animation\n   * Delegates to PageTransition.showPageTransition for the actual animation\n   * @param {HTMLElement} element - The page transition overlay element to animate\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the show animation is complete\n   * @example\n   * const overlay = document.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay');\n   * await transitionsManager.showPageTransition(overlay);\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        const fallbackImage = 'https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp';\n        const htmlHasValidImage = imageElement.src &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== '' &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== fallbackImage;\n        const imageMatchesSessionStorage = imageElement.src === transitionData.image;\n        \n        if (htmlHasValidImage &amp;&amp; !imageMatchesSessionStorage) {\n          this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n          return;\n        }\n        \n        const imageAlreadyCorrect = imageMatchesSessionStorage &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.complete &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.naturalHeight &gt; 0;\n        \n        if (!imageAlreadyCorrect)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Link transitions that animate between pages\n */\nexport class PageTransition {\n  constructor() {\n    this.timelines = [];\n  }\n\n  async showPageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const transitionTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      transitionTimeline\n        .to(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          duration: 1.25,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        })\n        .set(element, {\n          opacity: 1,\n          delay: .5,\n        });\n    });\n  }\n\n  async hidePageTransition(element) {\n    if (!element) {\n      return Promise.resolve();\n    }\n\n    this.transitionImage = $(\".page-transition-overlay__image\", element);\n\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const hideTimeline = gsap.timeline({\n        onComplete: () =&gt; {\n          resolve();\n        },\n      });\n\n      // ✅ CRITICAL: Animate the main element FIRST at position 0\n      // This ensures it always animates even if child elements don't exist\n      hideTimeline.to(\n        element,\n        {\n          opacity: 0,\n          duration: 1,\n          ease: \"power2.inOut\",\n        },\n        0\n      ); // Position 0 = start immediately\n    });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class PreloaderAnimation {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Remove and clean up the animation\n   * Kills the timeline and reverts SplitText instances\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  remove() {\n    // Kill any running animation\n    if (this.timeline) {\n      this.timeline.kill();\n      this.timeline = null;\n    }\n\n    // Clean up SplitText instances if they exist (new API)\n    if (this.splitTexts &amp;&amp; this.splitTexts.length &gt; 0) {\n      for (const split of this.splitTexts) {\n        if (split &amp;&amp; split.revert) {\n          split.revert(); // Revert SplitText changes (same API)\n        }\n      }\n      this.splitTexts = null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Destroy the animation (alias for remove for consistency)\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { Titles } from \"./Titles.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\nimport { createError, ERROR_CODES } from \"../utilities/ErrorRegistry.js\";\n\n/**\n * AnimationsManager handles page animations lifecycle\n * - Creates single IntersectionObserver per page\n * - Auto-detects data-animation attributes\n * - Registers and tracks animation instances\n * - Kills all animations on destroy\n */\nexport class AnimationsManager {\n  constructor() {\n    this.animationRegistry = {\n      title: Titles,\n      // Future: image: Images, parallax: Parallax\n    };\n    \n    // Current page state\n    this.pageAnimations = [];\n    this.intersectionObserver = null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Validates that the page element is a valid HTMLElement\n   * @param {HTMLElement} pageElement - The page container element to validate\n   * @returns {void}\n   * @throws {Error} Throws if pageElement is null, undefined, or not an HTMLElement\n   */\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Page Animation System Documentation\n\n## Overview\n\nThe animation system automatically handles page animations based on &#96;data-animation&#96; attributes in your HTML. It uses a single &#96;IntersectionObserver&#96; per page to efficiently trigger animations when elements enter or leave the viewport.\n\n**Key Components:**\n- **&#96;AnimationsManager&#96;**: Manages the animation lifecycle, auto-detects animated elements, and coordinates a shared IntersectionObserver\n- **&#96;Titles&#96;**: Animation class that fades in title elements when they enter the viewport\n- **Page Integration**: &#96;Page.js&#96; calls the manager during create/destroy lifecycle\n\n## How to Set Up a Page Animation\n\n### Step 1: Add &#96;data-animation&#96; Attribute to HTML\n\nSimply add the &#96;data-animation&#96; attribute to any element you want to animate:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;html\n&lt;h2 data-animation=\"title\"&gt;My Animated Title&lt;/h2&gt;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe attribute value (&#96;\"title\"&#96;) corresponds to an animation class registered in the &#96;AnimationsManager&#96; ## Root Cause Analysis

**Hard refresh (sessionStorage cleared):**
1. Preloader runs → preloads all page images
2. TransitionsManager initializes → schedules transition image preload via `requestIdleCallback` or `setTimeout(2000)`
3. Navigation happens after a delay → transition images are likely preloaded → works

**Reload (sessionStorage persists):**
1. Preloader doesn't run (`Preloader.shouldShow()` returns `false` because `'preloaderShown'` exists)
2. TransitionsManager initializes → schedules transition image preload lazily via `requestIdleCallback` or `setTimeout(2000)`
3. Overlay is visible by default (`opacity: 1` in CSS)
4. `MPAPageTransition.initialize()` runs:
   - `isPageNavigating` = `false` (no `'pageTransition'` key)
   - Sets overlay to `opacity: 0` immediately
5. User navigates immediately:
   - Overlay becomes visible
   - Transition images are still being preloaded (waiting for idle callback or setTimeout)
   - Images aren't ready → broken images

**The Problem:**
Transition images are preloaded lazily (`requestIdleCallback` or `setTimeout(2000)`). When the preloader doesn't run, there's no guarantee they're ready before navigation. The overlay hides immediately when not navigating, but when navigation happens, images may not be ready.

**The Solution:**
When the preloader doesn't run, preload transition images immediately (synchronously) instead of lazily, ensuring they're ready before navigation.

Should I create a plan to:
1. Detect when the preloader doesn't run
2. Preload transition images immediately (synchronously) in that case
3. Ensure images are ready before allowing navigation or hiding the overlay

Or would you prefer a different approach?

        "contents": "/**\n * LazyImageLoader - Loads images as they enter the viewport using Intersection Observer\n * \n * This utility is designed for viewport-based lazy loading of images. It uses the\n * Intersection Observer API to detect when images enter the viewport (or approach it),\n * then automatically loads them using the shared image loading utilities.\n * \n * Use cases:\n * - Lazy loading images on scroll for better initial page load performance\n * - Loading images only when they're about to be visible to the user\n * - Reducing bandwidth usage by deferring off-screen image loading\n * - Improving Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS) by prioritizing visible content\n * \n * @example\n * // Basic usage - automatically loads images when they enter viewport\n * const lazyLoader = new LazyImageLoader('img[data-src]');\n * \n * @example\n * // With custom options - load images 200px before they enter viewport\n * const lazyLoader = new LazyImageLoader('img[data-src]', {\n *   rootMargin: '200px',\n *   useDecode: true\n * });\n * \n * @example\n * // Load images in a specific container\n * const container = document.querySelector('.gallery');\n * const lazyLoader = new LazyImageLoader('img[data-src]', {\n *   container: container\n * });\n * \n * @example\n * // Cleanup when done\n * lazyLoader.destroy();\n */\nexport class LazyImageLoader {\n  /**\n   * Creates a new LazyImageLoader instance\n   * @param {string|HTMLElement[]|NodeList} selector - CSS selector, array of elements, or NodeList of images to lazy load\n   * @param {Object} [options] - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} [options.container=document] - Container to search for images in\n   * @param {string} [options.rootMargin='0px'] - Margin around the root bounding box (e.g., '200px' loads images 200px before viewport)\n   * @param {number|number[]} [options.threshold=0] - Threshold(s) for intersection (0 = trigger when any part visible, 1 = fully visible)\n   * @param {boolean} [options.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() for layout-ready images\n   * @param {Function} [options.onImageLoad] - Callback fired when each image loads: (imageElement) =&gt; void\n   */\n  constructor(selector, options = {}) {\n    const {\n      container = document,\n      rootMargin = '0px',\n      threshold = 0,\n      useDecode = true,\n      onImageLoad\n    } = options;\n\n    this.selector = selector;\n    this.container = container;\n    this.rootMargin = rootMargin;\n    this.threshold = threshold;\n    this.useDecode = useDecode;\n    this.onImageLoad = onImageLoad;\n    \n    this.imageService = new ImageService();\n    this.images = this.imageService.normalizeImages(selector, container);\n    this.observer = null;\n    this.loadedImages = new Set();\n    \n    // Start observing immediately\n    this.observe();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Starts observing images with Intersection Observer\n   * Automatically called on instantiation\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single image with decode support and state management\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n  async loadImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n    // Handle already-loaded images (cached)\n    if (this.isImageLoaded(element)) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, useDecode, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    const dataSrc = element.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC);\n    if (!dataSrc) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, false, onLoad);\n    }\n\n    // Track URL for preloading\n    const url = dataSrc;\n    \n    // Check if already preloaded\n    if (this.isImagePreloaded(url)) {\n      // Image is cached, just set src and wait for load event\n      element.src = url;\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    }\n\n    // Check if currently loading\n    if (this.loadingPromises.has(url)) {\n      // Wait for existing load to complete\n      await this.loadingPromises.get(url);\n      element.src = url;\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    }\n\n    // Get appropriate loader strategy\n    const loader = this.getImageLoader(useDecode, element);\n    \n    // Create loading promise and track it\n    const loadPromise = loader({ element, dataSrc, useDecode, onLoad })\n      .then((result) =&gt; {\n        // Mark as preloaded on success\n        if (result) {\n          this.preloadedUrls.add(url);\n        }\n        this.loadingPromises.delete(url);\n        return result;\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        this.loadingPromises.delete(url);\n        throw error;\n      });\n    \n    this.loadingPromises.set(url, loadPromise);\n    \n    return loadPromise;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload multiple images with support for progress tracking and decoding\n   * \n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement[]|NodeList|string} options.images - Array of image elements, NodeList, or CSS selector\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} options.container - Container to search in (default: document)\n   * @param {Function} options.onProgress - Callback fired when each image loads: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; void\n   * @param {Function} options.onImageLoad - Callback fired per image: (imageElement, index) =&gt; void\n   * @param {boolean} options.excludePreloader - Exclude images inside .preloader (default: false)\n   * @param {boolean} options.useDecode - Use decode() for layout-ready images (default: true)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Router use case - simple wait\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({ images: 'img[data-src]' });\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Preloader use case - with progress tracking\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({\n   *   images: this.images,\n   *   excludePreloader: true,\n   *   onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n   *     this.updateProgress(loaded, total, percentage);\n   *   }\n   * });\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\nprepareImages(images, container, excludePreloader) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads a single image with decode support\n   * When useDecode is true, decodes the image off-DOM before setting src on the DOM element\n   * to prevent flicker/repaint issues.\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n  async loadSingleImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n    // Handle already-loaded images (cached)\n    if (this.isImageLoaded(element)) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, useDecode, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    const dataSrc = element.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC);\n    if (!dataSrc) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, false, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    // Get appropriate loader strategy\n    const loader = this.getImageLoader(useDecode, element);\n    return loader({ element, dataSrc, useDecode, onLoad });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single image with decode support and state management\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class LazyImageLoader {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Starts observing images with Intersection Observer\n   * Automatically called on instantiation\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  observe() {\n    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {\n      console.warn('IntersectionObserver not supported. Loading all images immediately.');\n      this.loadAllImages();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (this.observer) {\n      return; // Already observing\n    }\n\n    this.observer = new IntersectionObserver(\n      (entries) =&gt; {\n        entries.forEach(entry =&gt; {\n          if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n            this.loadImage(entry.target);\n            this.observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n          }\n        });\n      },\n      {\n        rootMargin: this.rootMargin,\n        threshold: this.threshold\n      }\n    );\n\n    // Observe all images that haven't been loaded yet\n    this.images.forEach(img =&gt; {\n      if (!this.loadedImages.has(img) &amp;&amp; !this.imageService.isImageLoaded(img)) {\n        this.observer.observe(img);\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads a single image when it enters the viewport\n   * @private\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element to load\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads an image with decode support - decodes off-DOM before setting src to prevent flicker\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {string} params.dataSrc - Source URL from data-src attribute\n   * @param {Function} params.onLoad - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded and decoded\n   */\n  async loadImageWithDecode({ element, dataSrc, onLoad }) {\n    try {\n      // Load and decode image off-DOM\n      const tempImg = await this.loadImageOffDOM(dataSrc);\n      await this.decodeImageOffDOM(tempImg, dataSrc);\n      \n      // Image is now loaded and decoded - set src on DOM element (will be instant since cached)\n      element.src = dataSrc;\n      \n      // Wait for DOM element's load event (should fire immediately since cached)\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      \n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;Error loading image ${dataSrc}:&#96;, error);\n      onLoad?.(element); // Still call onLoad for progress tracking\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads an image using traditional approach (onload event, optional decode after)\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {string} params.dataSrc - Source URL from data-src attribute\n   * @param {boolean} params.useDecode - Whether to decode after load\n   * @param {Function} params.onLoad - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load all page images including navigation overlay background\n   * Uses ImageService to load all images with data-src attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   */\n  async loadPageImages() {\n    try {\n      await this.imageService.preloadImages({\n        images: 'img[data-src]',\n        excludePreloader: true,\n        useDecode: true,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn('Error loading page images:', error);\n      // Continue even if image loading fails\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Store transition data in sessionStorage for persistence across page loads\n   * @param {Object} transitionData - Transition data object with image, alt, copy\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   */\n  async preloadSingleImage(imgElement) {\n    if (!imgElement || !imgElement.dataset.src) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    const url = imgElement.dataset.src;\n\n    // Skip if already preloaded\n    if (this.isImagePreloaded(url)) {\n      return imgElement;\n    }\n\n    // Check if currently loading\n    if (this.loadingPromises.has(url)) {\n      return this.loadingPromises.get(url);\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const result = await this.loadImage({\n        element: imgElement,\n        useDecode: true,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload image: ${url}&#96;, error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n}",
        "signatures": {

        "contents": "/**\n * Constants for the application\n * Prevent the use of \"magic strings\" by providing a single source of truth for all selectors, attributes, events, and other constants used across the app\n * Wrap objects in Object.freeze() to prevent mutation outside of this class\n *\n * Problems with \"magic strings\":\n * - Typos not caught until runtime\n * - Hard to refactor (change selector? search entire codebase!)\n * - No single source of truth\n * - Easy to miss when updating\n */\n\n/**\n * CSS selectors\n */\nexport const SELECTORS = Object.freeze({\n  // Main structure\n  MAIN: \"main\",\n  MAIN_WITH_TEMPLATE: \"main[data-template]\",\n  BODY: \"body\",\n\n  // Preloader\n  PRELOADER: \".preloader\",\n  PRELOADER_TITLE: \".preloader h1\",\n  PRELOADER_COUNTER: \".preloader-counter\",\n  PRELOADER_COPY: \".preloader-transition-copy h1\",\n  PRELOADER_COPY_CONTAINER: \".preloader-transition-copy\",\n  PRELOADER_IMAGE: \"img[data-src].preloader-transition-image__img\",\n\n  // Page transitions\n  TRANSITION_OVERLAY: \".page-transition-overlay\",\n  TRANSITION_TEMPLATES: \"#page-transition-overlay-templates\",\n  TRANSITION_COPY: \".page-transition-overlay__copy\",\n  TRANSITION_IMAGE: \".page-transition-overlay__image\",\n\n\n  // Footnotes\n  FOOTNOTES: \"ul.footnotes li\",\n  SUPERSCRIPT_LINKS: \".page-content a.footnote-superscript-link\",\n  SUPERSCRIPT_LINK: \"a.footnote-superscript-link\",\n  FOOTNOTE_LINK: \"a.footnote-link\",\n\n\n  // Navigation\n  NAV: \"nav\",\n  NAV_LINKS: \"nav a\",\n  LINK: \".link\",\n  INTERNAL_LINK: \"a.internal-link\",\n  NAV_TOGGLE: \".navigation__toggle\",\n  NAV_TITLE: \".navigation__title\",\n\n  // Page content\n  PAGE_CONTENT: \"section.page-template\",\n\n  // Images\n  LAZY_IMAGES: \"img[data-src]\",\n\n  // Animations\n  ANIMATIONS_ATTRIBUTE: \"[data-animation]\",\n  TITLE_ANIMATIONS: '[data-animation=\"title\"]',\n  \n  // HTML elements\n  TEMPLATE: \"template\",\n  IMG: \"img\",\n});\n\n/**\n * HTML attribute names\n */\nexport const ATTRIBUTES = Object.freeze\n;",

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    // Guard: Check if initialized\n    if (!this.transitionTemplates) {\n      console.warn(\"TransitionsManager not initialized. Call init() first.\");\n      return;\n    }\n\n    route = this.normalizeRoute(route);\n\n    // Fix: Add null check for querySelector result\n    const transitionTemplate = this.transitionTemplates.querySelector(\n      &#96;${SELECTORS.TEMPLATE}[${ATTRIBUTES.DATA_ID}=\"${route}\"]&#96;\n    );\n\n    if (!transitionTemplate) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition template not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Get the original image from the template (before cloning)\n    const templateImg = transitionTemplate.content.querySelector(SELECTORS.IMG);\n    \n    if (!templateImg || !templateImg.dataset.src) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const imageUrl = templateImg.dataset.src;\n\n    // CRITICAL FIX: Ensure image is preloaded/loaded before displaying\n    // This prevents race condition where transition starts before image is ready\n    // Preload using the template image (which is in the template DOM)\n    if (!this.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      // Preload the template image and wait for it to complete\n      await this.preloadSingleImage(templateImg);\n    }\n\n    // Now clone the template (image should be cached at this point)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads an image using traditional approach (onload event, optional decode after)\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {string} params.dataSrc - Source URL from data-src attribute\n   * @param {boolean} params.useDecode - Whether to decode after load\n   * @param {Function} params.onLoad - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n  async loadImageWithoutDecode({ element, dataSrc, useDecode, onLoad }) {\n    return new Promise((resolve) =&gt; {\n      const controller = new AbortController();\n      const { signal } = controller;\n      \n      const handleLoad = async () =&gt; {\n        controller.abort(); // Cleanup listeners\n        \n        const decodedElement = useDecode ? await this.decodeImage(element) : element;\n        onLoad?.(decodedElement);\n        resolve(decodedElement);\n      };\n      \n      const handleError = () =&gt; {\n        controller.abort(); // Cleanup listeners\n        // Count failed images to prevent hanging\n        onLoad?.(element);\n        resolve(null);\n      };\n      \n      element.addEventListener('load', handleLoad, { signal });\n      element.addEventListener('error', handleError, { signal });\n      \n      // Start loading\n      if (!element.src) {\n        element.src = dataSrc;\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Gets the appropriate image loader strategy based on decode support\n   * @param {boolean} useDecode - Whether decode is requested\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} element - Image element to check for decode support\n   * @returns {Function} The appropriate loader function\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\nasync loadImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload multiple images with support for progress tracking and decoding\n   * \n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement[]|NodeList|string} options.images - Array of image elements, NodeList, or CSS selector\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} options.container - Container to search in (default: document)\n   * @param {Function} options.onProgress - Callback fired when each image loads: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; void\n   * @param {Function} options.onImageLoad - Callback fired per image: (imageElement, index) =&gt; void\n   * @param {boolean} options.excludePreloader - Exclude images inside .preloader (default: false)\n   * @param {boolean} options.useDecode - Use decode() for layout-ready images (default: true)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Router use case - simple wait\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({ images: 'img[data-src]' });\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Preloader use case - with progress tracking\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({\n   *   images: this.images,\n   *   excludePreloader: true,\n   *   onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n   *     this.updateProgress(loaded, total, percentage);\n   *   }\n   * });\n   */\n  async preloadImages({\n    images,\n    container = document,\n    onProgress,\n    onImageLoad,\n    excludePreloader = false,\n    useDecode = true,\n  } = {}) {\n    // Prepare and filter images\n    const imageElements = this.prepareImages(images, container, excludePreloader);\n    \n    if (imageElements.length === 0) {\n      return { loaded: 0, total: 0, images: [] };\n    }\n    \n    // Create progress tracker\n    const trackProgress = this.createProgressTracker(\n      imageElements.length,\n      onProgress,\n      onImageLoad\n    );\n    \n    // Load all images\n    const imagePromises = imageElements.map((element, index) =&gt; {\n      return this.loadImage({\n        element,\n        index,\n        useDecode,\n        onLoad: (img) =&gt; trackProgress(img, index)\n      });\n    });\n    \n    const results = await Promise.all(imagePromises);\n    \n    // Count successful loads (non-null results)\n    const loadedCount = results.filter(result =&gt; result !== null).length;\n    \n    return {\n      loaded: loadedCount,\n      total: imageElements.length,\n      images: imageElements\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Update overlay with transition data from SiteConfig\n   * Checks if image is preloaded, preloads if needed, then updates overlay markup\n   * @param {string} route - SiteConfig route key (e.g., \"/introduction\", \"/section-1\")\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated and image is loaded\n   */\n  async updateTransitionOverlay(route) {\n    if (!this.siteConfig || !route) {\n      console.warn('Cannot update transition overlay: missing siteConfig or route');\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const routeConfig = this.siteConfig.get(route);\n    if (!routeConfig || !routeConfig.transition) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Transition data not found for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const transitionData = routeConfig.transition;\n    const imageUrl = transitionData.image;\n\n    if (!imageUrl) {\n      console.warn(&#96;No transition image URL for route: ${route}&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check if image is preloaded\n    let imageReady = false;\n    if (this.transitionsManager &amp;&amp; this.transitionsManager.isImagePreloaded(imageUrl)) {\n      imageReady = true;\n    } else {\n      // Preload image if not already loaded\n      try {\n        const tempImg = document.createElement('img');\n        tempImg.setAttribute('data-src', imageUrl);\n        tempImg.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; // Match preload link crossorigin\n        \n        if (this.transitionsManager) {\n          await this.transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(tempImg);\n        } else {\n          await this.imageService.loadImage({ element: tempImg });\n        }\n        imageReady = true;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.warn(&#96;Failed to preload transition image for route ${route}:&#96;, error);\n        // Continue anyway - image may still load\n      }\n    }\n\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    if (imageElement) {\n      // Ensure crossorigin matches preload link\n      imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class Preloader extends Component {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Wait for images to load and then update the DOM with the path\n   */\n  async createLoader() {\n    // If no images to load, wait for background image and complete\n    if (this.images.length === 0) {\n      await this.startPreloaderAnimation();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Preload page images using ImageService\n    const pageImagesPromise = this.imageLoader.preloadImages({\n      images: this.images,\n      excludePreloader: false,\n      useDecode: true,\n      onProgress: (imagesLoaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n        this.imagesLoaded = imagesLoaded;\n        this.percentage = percentage;\n       \n        // Update the counter element if it exists\n        if (this.elements.counter) {\n          this.elements.counter.innerHTML = &#96;${percentage}%&#96;;\n        }\n      }\n    }).catch((error) =&gt; {\n      console.error('Error preloading images:', error);\n      // Return empty result to prevent hanging\n      return { loaded: 0, total: 0, images: [] };\n    });\n\n    // Wait for images to complete\n    const pageImagesResult = await pageImagesPromise;\n\n    // Check if all images loaded and the animation hasn't started yet\n    if (pageImagesResult &amp;&amp; pageImagesResult.loaded === pageImagesResult.total &amp;&amp; !this.animationStarted) {\n      await this.startPreloaderAnimation();\n    }\n  }\n  \n\n  /**\n   * Play the preloader animation\n   * Delegates to PreloaderAnimation class for animation logic\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class LazyImageLoader {\nunobserve(imgElement) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Adds new images to observe (useful for dynamically added content)\n   * @param {string|HTMLElement[]|NodeList} selector - New images to observe\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  addImages(selector) {\n    const newImages = this.imageService.normalizeImages(selector, this.container);\n    newImages.forEach(img =&gt; {\n      if (!this.images.includes(img)) {\n        this.images.push(img);\n        if (this.observer &amp;&amp; !this.imageService.isImageLoaded(img)) {\n          this.observer.observe(img);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Destroys the LazyImageLoader and cleans up resources\n   * Disconnects the IntersectionObserver and clears references\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Restore transition data from sessionStorage and update overlay markup\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when overlay is updated\n   */\n  async restoreTransitionData() {\n    try {\n      const storedData = this.sessionStorage.getItem('pageTransitionImage');\n      if (!storedData) return;\n\n      const transitionData = JSON.parse(storedData);\n      const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; transitionData.image) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        const fallbackImage = 'https://shea-memorandum-site.b-cdn.net/images/home-theme-desktop.webp';\n        const htmlHasValidImage = imageElement.src &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== '' &amp;&amp; \n                                  imageElement.src !== fallbackImage;\n        const imageMatchesSessionStorage = imageElement.src === transitionData.image;\n        \n        if (htmlHasValidImage &amp;&amp; !imageMatchesSessionStorage) {\n          this.sessionStorage.removeItem('pageTransitionImage');\n          return;\n        }\n        \n        const imageAlreadyCorrect = imageMatchesSessionStorage &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.complete &amp;&amp; \n                                   imageElement.naturalHeight &gt; 0;\n        \n        if (!imageAlreadyCorrect)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class MPAPageTransition {\n\n\n  async initialize() {\n    if (!this.gsap) {\n      console.error(\n        \"GSAP is not loaded. Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found. Transition animations may not work.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.isPageNavigating = this.sessionStorage.getItem(\"pageTransition\") === \"true\";\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    \n    this.setupListeners();\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      const imageAfterRestore = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageAfterRestore &amp;&amp; imageAfterRestore.src) {\n        imageAfterRestore.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        if (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n          await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n        }\n        \n        void imageAfterRestore.offsetHeight;\n        await new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n      }\n      \n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      await this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Initial state: overlay hidden\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        opacity: 0\n      });\n      \n      // Ensure crossorigin is set for future use\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; imageElement.src) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener\n\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * ImageService - Unified image loading service\n * Consolidates image loading functionality from Images.js and ImageLoader.js\n * Handles loading images from data-src to src, decoding, progress tracking, and preloading\n * Provides a single source of truth for image loading across the application\n */\n\nimport { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from './Constants.js';\n\n/**\n * ImageService class - Unified image loading with progress tracking and preloading\n */\nexport class ImageService {\n  constructor() {\n    this.preloadedUrls = new Set();\n    this.loadingPromises = new Map(); // Track in-flight loads to avoid duplicates\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Normalizes various image input types into an array of image elements\n   * @param {HTMLElement[]|NodeList|string|HTMLElement} images - Images as array, NodeList, selector, or single element\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} container - Container to search in\n   * @returns {HTMLImageElement[]} Array of image elements\n   */\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "/**",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "text": " * ImageService - Unified image loading service",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": " * Consolidates image loading functionality from Images.js and ImageLoader.js",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": " * Handles loading images from data-src to src, decoding, progress tracking, and preloading",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": " * Provides a single source of truth for image loading across the application",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": " */",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "import { SELECTORS, ATTRIBUTES } from './Constants.js';",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {

        "contents": "export class TransitionsManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Preload a single image element (used when needed during transition)\n   * Skips preloading if the image is already in the preloaded set\n   * Uses ImageService for consistent behavior\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element with data-src attribute to preload\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when image is loaded or fails silently\n   * @example\n   * const img = document.querySelector('img[data-src]');\n   * await transitionsManager.preloadSingleImage(img);\n   */\n  async preloadSingleImage(imgElement) {\n    if (!imgElement || !imgElement.dataset.src) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      return await this.imageLoader.preloadSingleImage(imgElement);\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(\n        &#96;Failed to preload transition image: ${imgElement.dataset.src}&#96;,\n        error\n      );\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Queries the transition template and updates the page transition overlay with the custom transition markup\n   * Normalizes the route, finds the matching template, ensures image is loaded,\n   * and updates the DOM with the transition content\n   * \n   * FIX: Ensures image is fully loaded before setting src and updating DOM to prevent race condition\n   * \n   * @param {string} route - The route to get the transition for (e.g., \"/home\" or \"home\"), maps to the template data-id attribute\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;} Resolves when the transition overlay is updated and image is ready\n   * @throws {Error} Logs warnings if TransitionsManager is not initialized or template is not found\n   * @example\n   * // Called in Page.hide()\n   * await this.transitionsManager.updateTransitionOverlay(\"/section-1\");\n   */\n}",

{
  "codeResults": [
    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/utilities/LazyImageLoader.js",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 194,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "/**\n * LazyImageLoader - Loads images as they enter the viewport using Intersection Observer\n * \n * This utility is designed for viewport-based lazy loading of images. It uses the\n * Intersection Observer API to detect when images enter the viewport (or approach it),\n * then automatically loads them using the shared image loading utilities.\n * \n * Use cases:\n * - Lazy loading images on scroll for better initial page load performance\n * - Loading images only when they're about to be visible to the user\n * - Reducing bandwidth usage by deferring off-screen image loading\n * - Improving Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS) by prioritizing visible content\n * \n * @example\n * // Basic usage - automatically loads images when they enter viewport\n * const lazyLoader = new LazyImageLoader('img[data-src]');\n * \n * @example\n * // With custom options - load images 200px before they enter viewport\n * const lazyLoader = new LazyImageLoader('img[data-src]', {\n *   rootMargin: '200px',\n *   useDecode: true\n * });\n * \n * @example\n * // Load images in a specific container\n * const container = document.querySelector('.gallery');\n * const lazyLoader = new LazyImageLoader('img[data-src]', {\n *   container: container\n * });\n * \n * @example\n * // Cleanup when done\n * lazyLoader.destroy();\n */\nexport class LazyImageLoader {\n  /**\n   * Creates a new LazyImageLoader instance\n   * @param {string|HTMLElement[]|NodeList} selector - CSS selector, array of elements, or NodeList of images to lazy load\n   * @param {Object} [options] - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} [options.container=document] - Container to search for images in\n   * @param {string} [options.rootMargin='0px'] - Margin around the root bounding box (e.g., '200px' loads images 200px before viewport)\n   * @param {number|number[]} [options.threshold=0] - Threshold(s) for intersection (0 = trigger when any part visible, 1 = fully visible)\n   * @param {boolean} [options.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() for layout-ready images\n   * @param {Function} [options.onImageLoad] - Callback fired when each image loads: (imageElement) =&gt; void\n   */\n  constructor(selector, options = {}) {\n    const {\n      container = document,\n      rootMargin = '0px',\n      threshold = 0,\n      useDecode = true,\n      onImageLoad\n    } = options;\n\n    this.selector = selector;\n    this.container = container;\n    this.rootMargin = rootMargin;\n    this.threshold = threshold;\n    this.useDecode = useDecode;\n    this.onImageLoad = onImageLoad;\n    \n    this.imageService = new ImageService();\n    this.images = this.imageService.normalizeImages(selector, container);\n    this.observer = null;\n    this.loadedImages = new Set();\n    \n    // Start observing immediately\n    this.observe();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Starts observing images with Intersection Observer\n   * Automatically called on instantiation\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class LazyImageLoader {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Starts observing images with Intersection Observer\n   * Automatically called on instantiation\n   * @returns {void}\n   */\n  observe() {\n    if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {\n      console.warn('IntersectionObserver not supported. Loading all images immediately.');\n      this.loadAllImages();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (this.observer) {\n      return; // Already observing\n    }\n\n    this.observer = new IntersectionObserver(\n      (entries) =&gt; {\n        entries.forEach(entry =&gt; {\n          if (entry.isIntersecting) {\n            this.loadImage(entry.target);\n            this.observer.unobserve(entry.target);\n          }\n        });\n      },\n      {\n        rootMargin: this.rootMargin,\n        threshold: this.threshold\n      }\n    );\n\n    // Observe all images that haven't been loaded yet\n    this.images.forEach(img =&gt; {\n      if (!this.loadedImages.has(img) &amp;&amp; !this.imageService.isImageLoaded(img)) {\n        this.observer.observe(img);\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads a single image when it enters the viewport\n   * @private\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element to load\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class LazyImageLoader {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads a single image when it enters the viewport\n   * @private\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgElement - Image element to load\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n  async loadImage(imgElement) {\n    if (this.loadedImages.has(imgElement) || this.imageService.isImageLoaded(imgElement)) {\n      return; // Already loaded or loading\n    }\n\n    this.loadedImages.add(imgElement);\n\n    try {\n      await this.imageService.loadSingleImage({\n        element: imgElement,\n        useDecode: this.useDecode,\n        onLoad: (img) =&gt; {\n          this.onImageLoad?.(img);\n        }\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Failed to load image: ${imgElement.dataset?.src || imgElement.src}&#96;, error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads all images immediately (fallback for browsers without IntersectionObserver)\n   * @private\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;void&gt;}\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class Preloader extends Component {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Wait for images to load and then update the DOM with the path\n   */\n  async createLoader() {\n    // If no images to load, wait for background image and complete\n    if (this.images.length === 0) {\n      await this.startPreloaderAnimation();\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Preload page images using ImageService\n    const pageImagesPromise = this.imageLoader.preloadImages({\n      images: this.images,\n      excludePreloader: false,\n      useDecode: true,\n      onProgress: (imagesLoaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n        this.imagesLoaded = imagesLoaded;\n        this.percentage = percentage;\n       \n        // Update the counter element if it exists\n        if (this.elements.counter) {\n          this.elements.counter.innerHTML = &#96;${percentage}%&#96;;\n        }\n      }\n    }).catch((error) =&gt; {\n      console.error('Error preloading images:', error);\n      // Return empty result to prevent hanging\n      return { loaded: 0, total: 0, images: [] };\n    });\n\n    // Wait for images to complete\n    const pageImagesResult = await pageImagesPromise;\n\n    // Check if all images loaded and the animation hasn't started yet\n    if (pageImagesResult &amp;&amp; pageImagesResult.loaded === pageImagesResult.total &amp;&amp; !this.animationStarted) {\n      await this.startPreloaderAnimation();\n    }\n  }\n  \n\n  /**\n   * Play the preloader animation\n   * Delegates to PreloaderAnimation class for animation logic\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import Component from \"./Component.js\";\nimport { returnImagesArray, normalizeToArray } from \"../utilities/ArrayHelpers.js\";\nimport { ImageService } from \"../utilities/ImageService.js\";\nimport { PreloaderAnimation } from \"../animations/PreloaderAnimation.js\";\nimport { SELECTORS, EVENTS, BACKGROUND_IMAGES } from \"../utilities/Constants.js\";\n\n/**\n * Preloader element is displayed until all images are loaded and ready to be displayed\n */\n\nexport class Preloader extends Component {\n  constructor() {\n    super({\n      element: SELECTORS.PRELOADER,\n      elements: {\n        title: SELECTORS.PRELOADER_TITLE,\n        counter: SELECTORS.PRELOADER_COUNTER,\n        copy: SELECTORS.PRELOADER_COPY,\n        copyContainer: SELECTORS.PRELOADER_COPY_CONTAINER,\n        image: SELECTORS.PRELOADER_IMAGE,\n        images: SELECTORS.LAZY_IMAGES,\n      },\n    });\n    this.imageLoader = new ImageService();\n    this.preloaderAnimation = new PreloaderAnimation();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Check if preloader should be shown based on sessionStorage\n   * @returns {boolean} True if preloader should be shown\n   */\n}",
