        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single image with decode support and state management\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n  async loadImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n    // Handle already-loaded images (cached)\n    if (this.isImageLoaded(element)) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, useDecode, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    const dataSrc = element.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC);\n    if (!dataSrc) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, false, onLoad);\n    }\n\n    // Track URL for preloading\n    const url = dataSrc;\n    \n    // Check if already preloaded\n    if (this.isImagePreloaded(url)) {\n      // Image is cached, just set src and wait for load event\n      element.src = url;\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    }\n\n    // Check if currently loading\n    if (this.loadingPromises.has(url)) {\n      // Wait for existing load to complete\n      await this.loadingPromises.get(url);\n      element.src = url;\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    }\n\n    // Get appropriate loader strategy\n    const loader = this.getImageLoader(useDecode, element);\n    \n    // Create loading promise and track it\n    const loadPromise = loader({ element, dataSrc, useDecode, onLoad })\n      .then((result) =&gt; {\n        // Mark as preloaded on success\n        if (result) {\n          this.preloadedUrls.add(url);\n        }\n        this.loadingPromises.delete(url);\n        return result;\n      })\n      .catch((error) =&gt; {\n        this.loadingPromises.delete(url);\n        throw error;\n      });\n    \n    this.loadingPromises.set(url, loadPromise);\n    \n    return loadPromise;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload multiple images with support for progress tracking and decoding\n   * \n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement[]|NodeList|string} options.images - Array of image elements, NodeList, or CSS selector\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} options.container - Container to search in (default: document)\n   * @param {Function} options.onProgress - Callback fired when each image loads: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; void\n   * @param {Function} options.onImageLoad - Callback fired per image: (imageElement, index) =&gt; void\n   * @param {boolean} options.excludePreloader - Exclude images inside .preloader (default: false)\n   * @param {boolean} options.useDecode - Use decode() for layout-ready images (default: true)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Router use case - simple wait\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({ images: 'img[data-src]' });\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Preloader use case - with progress tracking\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({\n   *   images: this.images,\n   *   excludePreloader: true,\n   *   onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n   *     this.updateProgress(loaded, total, percentage);\n   *   }\n   * });\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "class App {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize page transition handler\n   */\n  async createPageTransition() {\n    if (this.pageTransition) return;\n    \n    // Create and initialize TransitionsManager for preloading transition images\n    if (!this.transitionsManager) {\n      this.transitionsManager = new TransitionsManager({ \n        siteConfig: this.siteConfig \n      });\n      await this.transitionsManager.init();\n    }\n    \n    this.pageTransition = new MPAPageTransition({\n      siteConfig: this.siteConfig,\n      transitionsManager: this.transitionsManager\n    });\n    await this.pageTransition.initialize();\n  }\n}\n\nconst app = new App();\nwhenDOMReady(() =&gt; {\n  app.init().catch\n\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\nprepareImages(images, container, excludePreloader) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads a single image with decode support\n   * When useDecode is true, decodes the image off-DOM before setting src on the DOM element\n   * to prevent flicker/repaint issues.\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n  async loadSingleImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n    // Handle already-loaded images (cached)\n    if (this.isImageLoaded(element)) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, useDecode, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    const dataSrc = element.getAttribute(ATTRIBUTES.DATA_SRC);\n    if (!dataSrc) {\n      return this.handleImageReady(element, false, onLoad);\n    }\n    \n    // Get appropriate loader strategy\n    const loader = this.getImageLoader(useDecode, element);\n    return loader({ element, dataSrc, useDecode, onLoad });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load a single image with decode support and state management\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {number} [params.index] - Index of the image (optional, for progress tracking)\n   * @param {boolean} [params.useDecode=true] - Whether to use decode() (decodes off-DOM before DOM insertion)\n   * @param {Function} [params.onLoad] - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "createNavigation() {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Display preloader on first page visit only (session-based)\n   */\n  createPreloader() {\n    // Don't create preloader if it's already been shown or if one already exists\n    if (!Preloader.shouldShow() || this.preloaderVisible || this.preloader) {\n      // If preloader already shown, hide element and ensure smoothScroll is ready\n      if (!Preloader.shouldShow()) {\n        const preloader = new Preloader();\n        preloader.hideIfAlreadyShown();\n        if (this.services.smoothScroll) {\n          if (!this.services.smoothScroll.isEnabled()) {\n            this.services.smoothScroll.create();\n          }\n          this.services.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, { immediate: true });\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const preloaderElement = $(SELECTORS.PRELOADER);\n    if (!preloaderElement) {\n      if (this.services.smoothScroll &amp;&amp; !this.services.smoothScroll.isEnabled()) {\n        this.services.smoothScroll.create();\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.preloader = new Preloader();\n    this.preloader.show();\n    this.preloader.create();\n\n    this.preloader.setupCompletionHandler(() =&gt; {\n      if (this.services.smoothScroll) {\n        this.services.smoothScroll.create();\n        this.services.smoothScroll.scrollTo(0, { immediate: true });\n      }\n      this.preloader = null;\n      this.preloaderVisible = true;\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Initialize page transition handler\n   */\n  async createPageTransition() {\n    if (this.pageTransition) return;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads an image with decode support - decodes off-DOM before setting src to prevent flicker\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {string} params.dataSrc - Source URL from data-src attribute\n   * @param {Function} params.onLoad - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded and decoded\n   */\n  async loadImageWithDecode({ element, dataSrc, onLoad }) {\n    try {\n      // Load and decode image off-DOM\n      const tempImg = await this.loadImageOffDOM(dataSrc);\n      await this.decodeImageOffDOM(tempImg, dataSrc);\n      \n      // Image is now loaded and decoded - set src on DOM element (will be instant since cached)\n      element.src = dataSrc;\n      \n      // Wait for DOM element's load event (should fire immediately since cached)\n      await this.waitForElementLoad(element);\n      \n      onLoad?.(element);\n      return element;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(&#96;Error loading image ${dataSrc}:&#96;, error);\n      onLoad?.(element); // Still call onLoad for progress tracking\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Loads an image using traditional approach (onload event, optional decode after)\n   * @param {Object} params\n   * @param {HTMLImageElement} params.element - Image element to load\n   * @param {string} params.dataSrc - Source URL from data-src attribute\n   * @param {boolean} params.useDecode - Whether to decode after load\n   * @param {Function} params.onLoad - Callback when image loads\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;HTMLImageElement|null&gt;} Resolves when loaded\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export class ImageService {\nasync loadImage({ element, index, useDecode = true, onLoad }) {\n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Preload multiple images with support for progress tracking and decoding\n   * \n   * @param {Object} options - Configuration options\n   * @param {HTMLElement[]|NodeList|string} options.images - Array of image elements, NodeList, or CSS selector\n   * @param {HTMLElement|Document} options.container - Container to search in (default: document)\n   * @param {Function} options.onProgress - Callback fired when each image loads: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; void\n   * @param {Function} options.onImageLoad - Callback fired per image: (imageElement, index) =&gt; void\n   * @param {boolean} options.excludePreloader - Exclude images inside .preloader (default: false)\n   * @param {boolean} options.useDecode - Use decode() for layout-ready images (default: true)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;{loaded: number, total: number, images: HTMLElement[]}&gt;} Resolves when all images are loaded\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Router use case - simple wait\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({ images: 'img[data-src]' });\n   * \n   * @example\n   * // Preloader use case - with progress tracking\n   * await imageService.preloadImages({\n   *   images: this.images,\n   *   excludePreloader: true,\n   *   onProgress: (loaded, total, percentage) =&gt; {\n   *     this.updateProgress(loaded, total, percentage);\n   *   }\n   * });\n   */\n  async preloadImages({\n    images,\n    container = document,\n    onProgress,\n    onImageLoad,\n    excludePreloader = false,\n    useDecode = true,\n  } = {}) {\n    // Prepare and filter images\n    const imageElements = this.prepareImages(images, container, excludePreloader);\n    \n    if (imageElements.length === 0) {\n      return { loaded: 0, total: 0, images: [] };\n    }\n    \n    // Create progress tracker\n    const trackProgress = this.createProgressTracker(\n      imageElements.length,\n      onProgress,\n      onImageLoad\n    );\n    \n    // Load all images\n    const imagePromises = imageElements.map((element, index) =&gt; {\n      return this.loadImage({\n        element,\n        index,\n        useDecode,\n        onLoad: (img) =&gt; trackProgress(img, index)\n      });\n    });\n    \n    const results = await Promise.all(imagePromises);\n    \n    // Count successful loads (non-null results)\n    const loadedCount = results.filter(result =&gt; Please ensure the GSAP script is included in the head.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.elements = {\n      transitionOverlay: document.querySelector(\".page-transition-overlay\"),\n      menuToggleBtn: document.querySelector(\".navigation__toggle\"),\n    };\n\n    // Check if transition overlay element exists\n    if (!this.elements.transitionOverlay) {\n      console.warn(\n        \"Page transition overlay element not found. Transition animations may not work.\",\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this.isPageNavigating = this.sessionStorage.getItem(\"pageTransition\") === \"true\";\n    const imageElement = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n    \n    this.setupListeners();\n\n    if (this.isPageNavigating) {\n      await this.restoreTransitionData();\n      \n      const imageAfterRestore = this.elements.transitionOverlay?.querySelector('.page-transition-overlay__image');\n      \n      if (imageAfterRestore &amp;&amp; imageAfterRestore.src) {\n        imageAfterRestore.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n        \n        if (!imageAfterRestore.complete || imageAfterRestore.naturalHeight === 0) {\n          await this.imageService.waitForImageLoad(imageAfterRestore);\n        }\n        \n        void imageAfterRestore.offsetHeight;\n        await new Promise(resolve =&gt; requestAnimationFrame(resolve));\n      }\n      \n      this.sessionStorage.removeItem(\"pageTransition\");\n      await this.hideTransition();\n    } else {\n      // Initial state: overlay hidden\n      this.gsap.set(this.elements.transitionOverlay, { \n        opacity: 0\n      });\n      \n      // Ensure crossorigin is set for future use\n      if (imageElement &amp;&amp; imageElement.src) {\n        imageElement.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  setupListeners() {\n    document.addEventListener\n\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Constants for the application\n * Prevent the use of \"magic strings\" by providing a single source of truth for all selectors, attributes, events, and other constants used across the app\n * Wrap objects in Object.freeze() to prevent mutation outside of this class\n *\n * Problems with \"magic strings\":\n * - Typos not caught until runtime\n * - Hard to refactor (change selector? search entire codebase!)\n * - No single source of truth\n * - Easy to miss when updating\n */\n\n/**\n * CSS selectors\n */\nexport const SELECTORS = Object.freeze({\n  // Main structure\n  MAIN: \"main\",\n  MAIN_WITH_TEMPLATE: \"main[data-template]\",\n  BODY: \"body\",\n\n  // Preloader\n  PRELOADER: \".preloader\",\n  PRELOADER_TITLE: \".preloader h1\",\n  PRELOADER_COUNTER: \".preloader-counter\",\n  PRELOADER_COPY: \".preloader-transition-copy h1\",\n  PRELOADER_COPY_CONTAINER: \".preloader-transition-copy\",\n  PRELOADER_IMAGE: \"img[data-src].preloader-transition-image__img\",\n\n  // Page transitions\n  TRANSITION_OVERLAY: \".page-transition-overlay\",\n  TRANSITION_TEMPLATES: \"#page-transition-overlay-templates\",\n  TRANSITION_COPY: \".page-transition-overlay__copy\",\n  TRANSITION_IMAGE: \".page-transition-overlay__image\",\n\n\n  // Footnotes\n  FOOTNOTES: \"ul.footnotes li\",\n  SUPERSCRIPT_LINKS: \".page-content a.footnote-superscript-link\",\n  SUPERSCRIPT_LINK: \"a.footnote-superscript-link\",\n  FOOTNOTE_LINK: \"a.footnote-link\",\n\n\n  // Navigation\n  NAV: \"nav\",\n  NAV_LINKS: \"nav a\",\n  LINK: \".link\",\n  INTERNAL_LINK: \"a.internal-link\",\n  NAV_TOGGLE: \".navigation__toggle\",\n  NAV_TITLE: \".navigation__title\",\n\n  // Page content\n  PAGE_CONTENT: \"section.page-template\",\n\n  // Images\n  LAZY_IMAGES: \"img[data-src]\",\n\n  // Animations\n  ANIMATIONS_ATTRIBUTE: \"[data-animation]\",\n  TITLE_ANIMATIONS: '[data-animation=\"title\"]',\n  \n  // HTML elements\n  TEMPLATE: \"template\",\n  IMG: \"img\",\n});\n\n/**\n * HTML attribute names\n */\nexport const ATTRIBUTES = Object.freeze\n;",

        "contents": "export class Home extends Page {\n\n\n  setupImagePreviewFollower() {\n    const wrappers = document.querySelectorAll(\"[data-follower-wrap]\");\n\n    wrappers.forEach((wrap) =&gt; {\n      const collection = wrap.querySelector(\"[data-follower-collection]\");\n      const items = wrap.querySelectorAll(\"[data-follower-item]\");\n      const follower = wrap.querySelector(\"[data-follower-cursor]\");\n      const followerInner = wrap.querySelector(\"[data-follower-cursor-inner]\");\n\n      let prevIndex = null;\n      let firstEntry = true;\n\n      const offset = 100; // The animation distance in %\n      const duration = 0.5; // The animation duration of all visual transforms\n      const ease = \"power2.inOut\";\n\n      // Initialize follower position\n      gsap.set(follower, { xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50 });\n\n      // Quick setters for x/y\n      const xTo = gsap.quickTo(follower, \"x\", {\n        duration: 0.6,\n        ease: \"power3\",\n      });\n      const yTo = gsap.quickTo(follower, \"y\", {\n        duration: 0.6,\n        ease: \"power3\",\n      });\n\n      // Move all followers on mousemove\n      window.addEventListener(\"mousemove\", (e) =&gt; {\n        xTo(e.clientX);\n        yTo(e.clientY);\n      });\n\n      // Enter/leave per item within this wrap\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export default class Page {\n\n\n  // ============================================\n  // LIFECYCLE: DESTROY\n  // ============================================\n\n  /**\n   * Remove page state to avoid memory leaks (duplicate animations on page return, etc...)\n   */\n  async destroy() {\n    if (this._destroyed) {\n      console.warn(&#96;Page ${this.id}.destroy() called multiple times&#96;);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    this._destroyed = true;\n\n    // NOTE: Destroy function are in reverse order of create\n    await this.beforeDestroy?.()\n    this.destroyPageAnimations();\n    this.removeEventListeners();\n    this.destroyComponents();\n    this.destroyElements();\n    await this.afterDestroy?.()\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Destroy the page animations\n   */\n  destroyPageAnimations() {\n    this.animationsManager.destroyPageAnimations();\n  }\n}",

## Root Cause

**The Problem:**
- Preloader preloads all page images (`img[data-src]`) via `preloadImages()`
- On reload, `Preloader.shouldShow()` returns `false` (because `'preloaderShown'` exists in sessionStorage)
- Preloader doesn't run → page images never get preloaded
- `MPAPageTransition.loadPageImages()` only runs in `hideTransition()`, which only runs when `isPageNavigating` is `true`
- On reload, `isPageNavigating` is `false`, so page images never get loaded
- `LazyImageLoader` exists but is never instantiated, so there's no fallback

**The Solution:**
When the preloader doesn't run, we need to ensure page images are still loaded. Options:

1. Load page images directly in `MPAPageTransition.initialize()` when preloader didn't run
2. Initialize `LazyImageLoader` as a fallback when preloader doesn't run
3. Load page images in `App.createPreloader()` when preloader doesn't run

Prefer option 1 or 2? Option 1 is simpler and consistent with existing code. Option 2 uses lazy loading, which may be better for performance.

Implemented option 1. Changes:

1. **Added Preloader import** — to check if the preloader ran
2. **Added fallback image loading** — in the `else` block (when not navigating), check if the preloader didn't run (`!Preloader.shouldShow()`), and if so, call `loadPageImages()` to load all page images

**How it works:**
- Hard refresh: Preloader runs → loads page images → works
- Reload: Preloader doesn't run → `MPAPageTransition.initialize()` detects this and loads page images → works
- Navigation: Preloader doesn't run → `hideTransition()` loads page images → works

This ensures page images load even when the preloader doesn't run, consistent with the existing code pattern.

**Verification checklist:**
- Clear sessionStorage and hard refresh → preloader runs, images load
- Reload any page → preloader doesn't run, but images still load via fallback
- Navigate between pages → transitions work, images load

## `loadPageImages()` usage

`loadPageImages()` is only used in `MPAPageTransition.js`:
- Line 29: Method definition
- Line 248: Called when preloader didn't run (reload case)
- Line 342: Called in `hideTransition()` when navigating

The Preloader uses `preloadImages()` directly (not `loadPageImages()`), so there's no overlap.

## Documentation created

Created `documentation/guides/PAGE_TRANSITION_TECHNIQUES.md` covering:

1. CSS-first visibility — why `opacity: 1` by default eliminates the race condition
2. Crossorigin matching — why it's needed for cache usage
3. Preventing stale sessionStorage overwrites — preserving correct HTML images
4. Image readiness checks — skipping redundant work
5. Force browser paint — ensuring images are rendered
6. Fallback image loading — handling the reload case
7. Await hideTransition — preventing content flash
8. Simple fade animation — why we removed scaleY

The doc includes:
- Code examples for each technique
- Why each technique is needed
- A flow diagram showing the sequence
- A testing checklist

Note: With `opacity: 1` in CSS, some image readiness checks are less critical, but they're documented for completeness and edge cases.
